a: "Vayyikra vo lifne harchov asher lifne shaar hammayim"! amar rav chisda: beezrat nashim.
Vekore "achare mot" veach beasor". vrminhi: medallegin benavi veen medallegin battora!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: kan — bichde sheyyifsok hatturegman, kan — bichde shello yifsok hatturegman.
Veha ala katane: medallegin benavi veen medallegin battora. vead kamma medallegin — ad kede shello yifsok hatturegman. michlal devattora kelal kelal la!
Ella amar abbaye, la kashya: kan beinyan echad, kan bishne inyaynin.
Vehatanya: medallegin battora beinyan echad, uvenavi bishne inyaynin. vechan vechan bichde shello yifsok hatturegman.
Veen medallegin minnavi lenavi. uvenavi shel shenem asar medallegin, uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato.
Vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko kulei. vechol kach lamma — shello lehotzi laaz al sefer tora.
"Uveasor shebbechomesh happekudim kore al pe". velichrecheh lesefer velikre! amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: lefi sheen gollin sefer tora batztzibbur.
Velayte sefer tora acharina velikre! rav huna bar yehuda amar: mishshum pegamo shel rishon. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: lefi sheen mevarchin beracha sheenah tzericha.

Umi chayyshinan lifgama? vehaamar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat mevi shalosh torot vekore: achat meinyayno shel yom, veachat shel rosh chodesh, veachat beshel chanukka!
Telata gavre bitlata sifre — lekka pegama, chad gavra bitre sifre — ikka pegama.

Umevarech aleha shemone berachot kulei. tanu rabbanan: [mevarchin] al hattora kederech shemmevarchin bevet hakkeneset, veal haavoda, veal hahodaa, veal mechilat avon — ketiknan. al hammikdash bifne atzmo, veal hakkohanim bifne atzman, al yisrael bifne atzman, veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah.

Vehashshear tefilla. tanu rabbanan: hashshear tefilla techinna rinna uvakkasha sheammecha yisrael tzerichin liuoshea. vechotem beshomea tefilla. mikkan veelach — kol echad veechad mevi sefer tora mittoch beto vekore bo. vechol kach lamma — kede lehareot chazuto lerabbim.
Mishna parashat hammelech ketzad? motzae yom tov harishon shel chag, bashshemini bemotzae sheviit, osin lo bima shel etz baazara vehu yoshev aleha, shenneemar: "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed vegomer".

Chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol notnah lammelech. vehammelech omed umekabbel, vekore yoshev.
Agrippas hammelech amad vekibbel vekara omed, veshibbechuhu chachamim. ucheshehiggia lelo tuchal latet alecha ish nochri", zalgu enav demaot. amru lo: al tityare agrippas, achinu atta, achinu atta!
Vekore mittechillat "elle haddevarim", ad "shema", ushema", "vehaya im shamoa", "asser teasser", "ki techalle laser", ufarashat hammelech, uverachot ukelalot, ad sheggomer kol happarasha.
Berachot shekkohen gadol mevarech otan — hammelech mevarech otan, ella shennoten shel regalim tachat mechilat heavon.
Gemara bashshemini salka datach? ema: bashsheminit.
Vechol hane lema li?
Tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "mikketz" — hava amena nimno mehasheta, veaf al gav dela mitreme bishmitta, ketav rachamana "shemitta".
Vei ketav rachamana "shemitta" — hava amena besof shemitta, ketav rachamana "bemoed".
Vei ketav "bemoed" — hava amena meresh shatta, ketav rachamana "bechag hassukkot".
Vei ketav rachamana "bechag hassukkot" — hava amena afillu yom tov acharon, ketav rachamana "bevo chol yisrael".
b: Meatchalta demoed.
Vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset. shamat minna cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav! amar abbaye: kullah mishshum kevodo demelech.

Vehammelech omed umekabbel vekore yoshev. agrippas hammelech amad vekibbel vekara omed. omed mikkelal deyoshev? vehaamar mar: en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad, shenneemar: "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai vayyomer vegomer"! kidamar rav chisda: beezrat nashim, hacha name beezrat nashim.

Veshibbechuhu chachamim. shibbechuhu, mikkelal deshappir avad? haamar rav ashe: afillu leman deamar nasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul, melech shemmachal al kevodo — en kevodo machul, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech", shettehe emato alecha!
Mitzva shane.
Ucheshehiggia lelo tuchal latet". tana mishshemeh derabbi natan: beotah shaa nitchayyeyvu sone yisrael kelayay — shehechenifu lo leagrippas.
Amar rabbi shimon ben chalafta: miyyom sheggavar egrofah shel chanuppa — nitavvevtu haddinin, venitkalkelu hammaasim, veen adam yachol lomar lachavero "maasay gedolim mimmaasecha".

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar mareva, veittema rabbi shimon ben pazzi: muttar lehachenif lirshaim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "lo yikkare od lenaval nadiv ulechilay lo yeamer shoa", mikkelal devaolam hazze shere.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar, mehacha: "kirot pene elohim vattirtzeni".

Ufeliga derabbi levi. deamar rabbi levi: mashal shel yaakov veesav lema haddavar dome? leadam shezzimmen et chavero vehikkir bo shemvakkesh lehorgo, amar lo: team tavshil ze sheani toem ketavshil shettaamti bevet hammelech. amar: yada leh malka, mistefe vela katel leh.
Amar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo chanuppa mevi af laolam, shenneemar: "vechanfe lev yasimu af", velo od ella sheen tefillato nishmaat, shenneemar: "lo yeshavveu ki asaram".
(Siman: af ubbar gehinnam beyado nidda gola).

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo chanuppa — afillu ubbarin shebbime imman mekallelin oto, shenneemar: "omer lerasha tzaddik atta yikkevuhu ammim yizamuhu leummim", veen "kov" ella kelala, shenneemar: "lo kabbo el", veen "leom" ella ubbarin, shenneemar: "uleom milleom yeematz".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo chanuppa nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "hoy haomrim lara tov velattov ra vegomer", ma ketiv acharav: "lachen keechol kash leshon esh vachashash lehava yirpe vegomer".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol hammachnif lachavero — sof nofel beyado, veim eno nofel beyado — nofel beyad banav, veim eno nofel beyad banav — nofel beyad ben beno, shenneemar: "vayyomer yirmeya hannavi [lachananya] amen ken yaase Adonai yakem Adonai et devarecha", uchetiv:

a: "Vayhi hu beshaar binyamin vesham baal pekidut ushemo yiriyya ben shelemya ben chananya vayyitpos et yirmeyahu hannavi lemor el hakkasdim atta nofel. vayyomer lo yirmeyahu sheker enenni nofel el hakkasdim vegomer", uchetiv: "veyitpos yirmeyahu vayviehu el hassarim".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol eda sheyyesh bah chanuppa — meusa kenidda, shenneemar: "ki adat chanef galmud", shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lenidda galmuda. may "galmuda" — gemula mibbalah.

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol eda sheyyesh bah chanuppa — lesof gola, ketiv hacha: "ki adat chanef galmud", uchetiv hatam: "veamart bilvavech mi yalad li et elle vaani shechula vegalmuda gola vesura vegomer".
Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: arba kittot en mekabbelot pene shechina: kat letzim, vechat chanefim, vechat shakkarim, vechat mesappere lashon hara.
Kat letzim — dichtiv: "mashach yado et lotztzim". kat chanefim — dichtiv: "ki lo lefanav chanef yavo". kat shakkarim — dichtiv: "dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay".
Kat mesappere lashon hara — dichtiv: "ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra", tzaddik atta Adonai — lo yagur bimgurecha ra.
Hadaran alach ellu neemarin

Meshuach milchama beshaa shemmedabber el haam — bilshon hakkodesh haya medabber, shenneemar: "vehaya kekarovchem el hammilchama veniggash hakkohen" — ze kohen meshuach milchama, "vedibber el haam" — bilshon hakkodesh.

"Veamar alehem shema yisrael vegomer al oyvechem" — velo al achechem, lo yehuda al shimon vela shimon al binyamin. sheim tippelu beyadam yerachamu alechem, kema shenneemar: "vayyakumu haanashim asher nikkevu veshemot vayyachaziku vashshivya vechol maarummehem hilbishu min hashshalal vayyalbishum vayyanilum vayyaachilum vayyashkum vaysuchum vaynahalum bachamorim lechol koshel vayvium yerecho ir hattemarim etzel achehem vayyashuvu shomron vegomer". al oyvechem attem holchim, sheim tippelu beyadam en merachamin alechem.

"Al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu vegomer". "al yerach levavchem" — mippene tzoholat susim vetzichtzuach charavot, "al tiru" — mippene haggafat terisin veshifat hakkalgassin, "al tachpezu" — mikkol keranot, "al taartzu" — mippene kol tzevochot.

"Ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem". hem bain benitzchono shel basar vadam, veattem baim benitzchono shel makom. pelishtim bau benitzchono shel golyat, ma haya sofo — lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. bene ammon bau benitzchono shel shovach, ma haya sofo — lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. veattem i attem ken, "ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem lehillachem lachem vegomer" — ze machane haaron.
Gemara may kaamar? hachi kaamar: shenneemar "vedibber", ulehallan omer "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol", ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh.

Tanu rabbanan: "veniggash hakkohen vedibber el haam". yachol kol kohen sheyyirtze — talmud lomar: "vedibberu hashshotrim", ma shotrim bimmunne, af kohen bimmunne. veema kohen gadol? dumeya deshoter, ma shoter sheyyesh memunne al gabbav — af kohen sheyyesh memunne al gabbav.

Kohen gadol name, haikka melech al gabbav! baavodato kaamar. veema segan! segan lav memunne hu. detanya, amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim: lamma segan memunne — sheim era bo pesul bechohen gadol, nichnas umeshammesh tachtav.

"Veamar alehem shema yisrael". may shena "shema yisrael"? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: afillu lo kiyyaymtem ella keriat shema shacharit vearvit — i attem nimsarin beyadam.
"Al yerach levavchem al tiru kulei". tanu rabbanan: paamayim medabber immam, achat bassefar, veachat bammilchama. bassefar ma hu omer —
b: Shimu divre maarche hammilchama, vechizru. bammilchama ma hu omer: "al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu veal taartzu". keneged arbaa devarim sheummot haolam osin: megifin, umeriin, tzovchin, veromsin.

Pelishtim bau benitzchono shel golyat kulei. golyat, amar rabbi yochanan: sheamad begilluy panim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "beru lachem ish veyered elay", veen "ish" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hareni mappilo al yad ben ish, shenneemar: "vedavid ben ish efrati hazze".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: bishlosha mekomot lechado piv leoto rasha. echad: "beru lachem ish veyered elay", veiddach: "im yuchal lehillachem itti vehikkani vegomer". veiddach, dekaamar leh ledavid: "hachelev anochi ki atta va elay bammaklot". david name amar leh "atta ba elay becherev uvachanit uvechidon"! hadar amar leh: "veanochi va elecha beshem Adonai tzevaot elohe (yisrael) maarchot yisrael asher cherafta".

"Vayyiggash happelishti hashekem vehaarev", amar rabbi yochanan: kede levattelan mikkeriat shema shacharit vearvit. "vayyityatztzav arbaim yom", amar rabbi yochanan: keneged arbaim yom shennittena bahen tora.

"Vayyetze ish habbenayim mimmachanot pelishtim vegomer". may "benayim"? amar rav: shemmevunne mikkol mum. ushemuel amar: benoni shebbeechav. deve rabbi shela amar: shehu asuy kevinyan. rabbi yochanan amar: bar mea pafe vachada nanay.
"Vegolyat shemo miggat". tane rav yosef: shehakkol dashin et immo kegat. ketiv "maarot", vekarenan "maarchot". tane rav yosef: shehakkol heeru beimmo.

Ketiv "harafa", uchetiv "orpa", rav ushemuel chad amar: "harafa" shemah, velamma nikra shemah "orpa" — shehakkol orfin otah meachareha, vechad amar: "orpa" shemah, velamma nikra shemah "harafa" — shehakkol dashin otah keharifot, vechen hu omer: "vattikkach haishsha vetifrosh hammasach al pene habbeer vattishtach alav harifot". vei baet ema mehacha: "im tichtosh et haevil bammachtesh betoch harifot baeli".
"Veet arbaat elle yulledu leharafa begat vayyippelu veyad david uveyad avadav". may ninhu? amar rav chisda: saf umadon golyat veyishbi benov.

"Vayyippelu veyad david uveyad avadav", dichtiv: "vattishshak orpa lachamotah verut davka bah". amar rabbi yitzchak, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavou bene hanneshuka, veyippelu beyad bene haddevuka. daresh rava: bischar arba demaot shehorida orpa al chamotah — zachta veyatzu mimmenna arbaa gibborim, shenneemar: "vattissena kolan vattivkena od",

Ketiv: "chetz chanito", vekarenan "etz chanito". amar rabbi elazar: adayin lo higgianu lachatzi shivcho shel oto rasha. mikkan sheasur lesapper beshivchan shel reshaim. vela liftach beh kelal! leodoe shevacheh dedavid.

"Bene ammon bau benitzchono shel shovach kulei". ketiv "shovach", uchetiv "shofach". rav ushemuel, chad amar: "shofach" shemo, velamma nikra shemo "shovach" — sheasuy keshovach. vechad amar: shovach shemo, velamma nikra shemo "shofach" — shekkol haroe oto nishpach lefanav kekiton.

"Ashpato kekever patuach kullam gibborim". rav ushemuel, veamri la rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: beshaa shezzorkin chetz osin ashpattot ashpattot shel chalalim, veshemma tomar sheummanin bakkerav — talmud lomar: "kullam gibborim". vechad amar: beshaa sheosin tzorchehen osin ashpattot ashpattot shel zevel, veshemma tomar mippene shechole meayim hem — talmud lomar: "kullam gibborim".
Amar rav mari, shema minna: hay man dinfish zivleh, choli meayim hu. lemay nafka minna? litrach benafsheh.
"Deaga velev ish yashchenna", rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar: yassichenna middato, vechad amar: yesichenna laacherim.
"Veattem i attem ken kulei", vechol kach lamma? mippene shehashshem vechol kinnuyav

a: Munnachin baaron. vechen hu omer: "vayyishlach otam moshe elef lammatte latztzava otam veet pinchas". "otam" — ellu sanhedrin, "pinchas" — ze meshuach milchama, "uchele hakkodesh" — ze aron veluchot shebbo, "vachatzotzrot hatterua" — ellu hashshofarot.

Tana: lo lechinnam halach pinchas lammilchama, ella lippara din avi immo, shenneemar: "vehammedanim machru oto el mitzrayim vegomer". lememra definchas miyyosef ate? veha ketiv: "veelazar ben aharon lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha". may lav, deate miyyitro sheppittem agalim laavoda zara? la, miyyosef sheppitpet beyitzro.

Vahalo shevatim mevazzin oto: reitem ben puti ze, ben sheppittem avi immo agalim laavoda zara, yaharog nasi miyyisrael! ella: i avu deimmeh miyyosef — immeh deimmeh miyyitro, vei immeh deimmeh miyyosef — avu deimmeh miyyitro. dayka name, dichtiv: "mibbenot putiel", tere mashma. shema minna.

Mishna "vedibberu hashshotrim el haam lemor mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho yelech veyashov leveto vegomer". echad habbone bet hatteven, bet habbakar, bet haetzim, bet haotzarot. echad habbone, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana.

"Umi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo vegomer" — echad hannotea kerem, veechad hannotea chamishsha ilane maachol, vaafillu mechameshet hamminin. echad hannotea, veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana.

"Umi haish asher eras ishsha vegomer", echad hameares et habbetula, veechad hameares et haalmana. afillu shomeret yavam, vaafillu shama shemmet achiv bammilchama — chozer uva lo. kol ellu vaellu shomin divre kohen maarche milchama, vechozrin. umesappekin mayim umazon, umetakkenin et hadderachim.

Veellu sheenan chozrin: habbone bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset, hannotea arbaa[5] ilane maachol vachamishsha ilane serak, hammachazir et gerushato, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin — lo haya chozer. rabbi yehuda omer: af habbone bayit al mechono — lo haya chozer. rabbi eliezer omer: af habbone bet levenim bashsharon — lo haya chozer.

Ellu sheen zazin mimmekoman: bana bayit vachanacho, nata kerem vechillelo, hannose et arusato, hakkones et yevimto, shenneemar: "naki yihye leveto shana echat". "leveto" — ze beto, "yihye" — ze karmo, "vesimmach et ishto" — zo ishto, "asher lakach" — lehavi et yevimto. en maspikin lahem mayim umazon, veen metakkenin et hadderachim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vedibberu hashshotrim", yachol devarim shel atzman? keshehu omer "veyasfu hashshotrim" — hare devarim shel atzman amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "vedibberu hashshotrim" — bedivre meshuach milchama hakkatuv medabber. ha ketzad? — kohen medabber veshoter mashmia.

Tane chada: kohen medabber veshoter mashmia, vetanya iddach: kohen medabber vechohen mashmia, vetanya iddach: shoter medabber veshoter mashmia. amar abbaye: ha ketzad? mivveniggash" vead "vedibberu" — kohen medabber vechohen mashmia, mivvedibberu" ad "veyasfu" — kohen medabber veshoter mashmia, mivveyasfu" veelach — shoter medabber veshoter mashmia.
"Mi haish asher bana vayit chadash kulei". tanu rabbanan: "asher bana", en li ella asher bana. lakach veyarash venittan lo bemattana minnayin — talmud lomar: "mi haish asher bana".

"Bayit", en li ella bayit. minnayin lerabbot bet hatteven, uvet habbakar, uvet haetzim, uvet haotzarot — talmud lomar: "asher bana", mikkol makom. yachol sheani merabbe af habbone bet shaar achsadra umirpeset, talmud lomar: "bayit", ma bayit harauy ledira — af kol harauy ledira.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "bayit" kemashmao. "lo chanach", "velo chanacho" — perat legazlan. lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili, dei rabbi yose haggelili ha amar: "verach hallevav", ze hammityayre
b: Meaverot shebbeyado!
Afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, kegon daavad teshuva vihav deme. i hachi, have leh lokeach velehdar! kevan demeikkara betorat gezela ata lideh — la.
"Umi haish asher nata kerem kulei". tanu rabbanan: "asher nata" — en li ella nata. lakach veyarash venittan lo bemattana, minnayin — talmud lomar: "umi haish asher nata".

"Kerem" — en li ella kerem, minnayin lerabbot chamishsha ilane maachol vaafillu mishshear minin — talmud lomar: "asher nata". yachol sheani merabbe hannotea arbaa ilane maachol vachamishsha ilane serak, talmud lomar: "kerem".

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "kerem" kemashmao. "lo chillel", "velo chillelo" — perat lemavrich ulemarkiv. veha anan tenan: echad hannotea veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv! amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda, la kashya: kan beharekavat issur, kan beharekavat hetter.

Hay harekavat hetter hechi dame? illema yalda beyaldah — tippok leh devae mehdar mishshum yalda rishona! ella yalda bizkena. vehaamar rabbi avahu: yalda shessibbecha bizkena, batla yalda bazzekena, veen bah din orla!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: leolam yalda beyalda, uchegon dinta lehach kammayyta lisyayg ulekorot. ditnan: hannotea lisyayg ulekorot — patur min haorla.
Umay shena yalda bizkena devatla, umay shena yalda beyalda dela batla?
Hatam i mimmelich ala — lav bat mehdar hi, hacha i mimmelich ala — bat mehdar hi [deha meikkara lefere kayyma]. midde dehave aalu meelehen, ditnan: alu meelehen — chayyayvin beorla.
Velokma becherem shel shene shuttafin, dehay hadar addideh vehay hadar addideh? amar rav pappa, zot omeret: kerem shel shene shuttafin — en chozrin alav meerche hammilchama.
Umay shena mechamishsha achin umet echad mehen bammilchama, dechullan chozrin? hatam — kol chad vechad karena beh "ishto", hacha — kol chad vechad la karena bay "karmo".

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: bemavrich ilan beyarak, vehay tanna hu detanya: hammavrich ilan beyarak, rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir mishshum rabbi yehuda ben gamda ish kefar akko, vachachamim osrin.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: ha manni — rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. la amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hatam "kerem" kemashmao? hacha name "nata" kemashmao: notea in, mavrich umarkiv la.

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: yalda pechuta mittefach — chayyevet beorla kol shenoteha, demitchazya kevat shatta. vehane mille shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav. aval kulleh kerem — kala it leh.
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: met tofes arba ammot likriat shema, dichtiv: "loeg larash cheref osehu".
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: churegta haggedela ben haachin — asura linnase laachin, demitchazya ki achatayyhu. vela hi, kala it lay lemilleta.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: leket shichcha ufea sheasaan begoren — hukebu lemaaser. amar ulla: la amaran ella bassade, aval bair — kala it leh lemilleta.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: yalda happechuta mittefach — enah mekaddeshet et hazzeraim. vehane mille shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav, aval (kulle) [kulleh] kerem — mekaddesh.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

a: Met tofes arba ammot letumea. vetanna tuna: chatzar hakkever, haomed betochah — tahor, vehu sheyyehu bah arba ammot, divre bet shammay. bet hillel omrim: arbaa tefachim. bamme devarim amurim — sheppitchah millemala, aval pitchah min hatztzad — divre hakkol arba ammot.

Kelappe leyay?! adderabba: min hatztzad — midderid venafek, millemala — i efshar dela maahil. ella: bamme devarim amurim sheppitchah min hatztzad, aval pitchah millemala, arba ammot. vehane mille, chatzar hakkever dimsayyeyma mechitzata, aval met bealma — tafes.

"Mi haish asher eras ishsha kulei", tanu rabbanan: "asher eras", echad hameares et habbetula, veechad hameares et haalmana, veechad shomeret yavam. vaafillu chamishsha achin, umet echad mehem bammilchama — kullan chozrin. "lo lakach", "velo lekachah" — perat lealmana lakkohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin.
Lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili, dei rabbi yose haggelili, ha amar "hayyare verach hallevav" — ze hammityayre meaverot shebbeyado?
Afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, kidrabba. deamar rabba: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyivol, ma taam: "lo yikkach" mishshum "lo yechallel" — mishshum hachi eno loke ad sheyyivol.

Tanu rabbanan: "asher bana", "asher nata", "asher eras", limmeda tora derech eretz: sheyyivne adam bayit, veyitta kerem, veachar kach yissa ishsha. veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "hachen bachutz melachtecha veattedah bassade lach achar uvanita vetecha". "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze bayit, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze kerem, "achar uvanita vetecha" — zo ishsha.

Davar acher: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze mishna, "achar uvanita vetecha" — ze gemara. davar acher: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra umishna, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze gemara, "achar uvanit vetecha" — ellu maasim tovim. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra umishna ugemara, "veattedah bassade lach" — ellu maasim tovim, "achar uvanita vetecha" — derosh vekabbel sachar.

Veellu sheenan chozrin: habbone bet shaar kulei. tana: im hosif bo dimos echad — chozer. rabbi eliezer omer: af habbone bet levenim bashsharon — lo haya chozer. tana: mippene shemmechaddeshin oto paamayim beshavua.

Veellu sheen zazin mimmekoman: bana bayit chadash vachanacho vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "ishsha chadasha" — en li ella ishsha chadasha, almana ugerusha minnayin — talmud lomar: "ishsha" mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "ishsha chadasha"? mi shechadasha lo, yatza machazir gerushato sheen chadasha lo.

Tanu rabbanan: "lo yetze batztzava". yachol batztzava hu delo yetze, aval yaspik mayim umazon vitakken hadderachim — talmud lomar: "velo yaavor alav lechol davar". yachol sheani merabbe af habbone bayit velo chanacho, nata kerem velo chillelo, eras ishsha velo lekachah — talmud lomar: "alav" — alav i atta maavir, aval atta maavir al acherim. umeachar dichtav "lo yaavor", "lo yetze batztzava" lema li? laavor alav bishne lavin.

Mishna "veyasfu hashshotrim ledabber el haam vegomer", rabbi akiva omer: "hayyare verach hallevav" — kemashmao, sheeno yachol laamod bekishre hammilchama velirot cherev shelufa. rabbi yose haggelili omer: "hayyare verach hallevav" — zehu hammityayre min haaverot shebbeyado, lefichach talta lo hattora et kol ellu, sheyyachzor biglalan.
Rabbi yose omer: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin — hare hu hayyare verach hallevav.

"Vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ledabber el haam ufakdu sare tzevaot berosh haam". uvaakevo shel am maamidin zekifin lifnehem, vaacherim meachorehem, vechashshilin shel barzel bidehen, vechol hamevakkesh lachzor — harshut beyado lekappeach et shokav.
b: Shettechillat nisa nefila, shenneemar: "nas yisrael lifne felishtim vegam maggefa gedola hayta vaam", ulehallan hu omer: "vayyanusu anshe yisrael mippene felishtim vayyippelu chalalim vegomer".

Bamme devarim amurim — bemilchamot harshut, aval bemilchamot mitzva — hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah. amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — bemilchamot mitzva, aval bemilchamot chova — hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah.
Gemara may ikka ben rabbi yose lerabbi yose haggelili? ikka benayyhu avera derabbanan.
Keman azla ha detanya: sach ben tefilla litfilla — avera hi beyado, vechozer aleha meorche hammilchama. keman — kerabbi yose haggelili.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: shama kol keranot vehirtia, haggafat terisin vehirtia, tzichtzuach charavot umayim shottin lo al birkav — chozer. keman — lema rabbi akiva hi vela rabbi yose haggelili? beha afillu rabbi yose haggelili mode, mishshum dichtiv: "velo yimmas et levav echav kilvavo".
"Vehaya kechallot hashshotrim kulei". hay mippene shettechillat nisa nefila, mippene shettechillat nefila nisa mibbee leh! ema mippene shettechillat nefila nisa.
Bamme devarim amurim bemilchamot harshut kulei, amar rabbi yochanan: reshut derabbanan zo hi mitzva derabbi yehuda, mitzva derabbanan zo hi chova derabbi yehuda.

Amar rava: milchamot yehoshua lechabbesh — divre hakkol chova, milchamot bet david lirvavcha — divre hakkol reshut. ki peligi lemaote nochrim dela layte alayyhu. mar kare la mitzva umar kare reshut. nafka minna leosek bemitzva sheppatur min hammitzva.
Hadaran alach meshuach milchama

Egla arufa bilshon hakkodesh, shenneemar: "ki yimmatze chalal baadama ... veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha". shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hayu yotzin, rabbi yehuda omer: chamishsha, shenneemar "zekenecha" — shenayim, "veshoftecha" — shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad.
Nimtza tamun baggal o taluy bailan o tzaf al pene hammayim — lo hayu orfin, shenneemar: "baadama" — velo tamun baggal, "nofel" — velo taluy bailan, "bassade" — velo tzaf al pene hammayim.
Nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sherubbah nochrim o leir sheen bah bet din — lo hayu orfin. en moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din.

Gemara may kaamar? amar rabbi avahu, hachi kaamar: shenneemar "veanu veamru", ulehallan hu omer "veanu haleviyyim veamru vegomer", ma aniyyay haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh — af kan bilshon hakkodesh.
Veseder egla arufa ketzad — "ki yimmatze chalal baadama ... veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha" — shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hayu yotzin. rabbi yehuda omer chamishsha vechulei.

Tanu rabbanan: "veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha". "zekenecha" — shenayim, "veshoftecha" — shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad, hare kan chamishsha. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: "zekenecha" — shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad, hare kan shelosha.
Verabbi shimon name, ha ketiv "veshoftecha"! hahu mibbee leh limyuchadin shebbeshoftecha. verabbi yehuda: mizzikne" "zekenecha" nafka.

Verabbi shimon: i ketav rachamana "zikne" — hava amena afillu zikne hashshuk, ketav rachamana "zekenecha". vei ketav rachamana "zekenecha" — hava amena afillu sanhedri ketanna, ketav rachamana "veshoftecha" — limyuchadin shebbeshoftecha.
Verabbi yehuda gemar "zikne" "zikne" mizzikne haeda": ma lehallan meyuchadin shebbaeda — af kan meyuchadin shebbaeda.
I gamar, ligmera lechulla milleta mehatam, "zekenecha veshoftecha" lema li? ella, vav "veshoftecha" leminyana. verabbi shimon —

a: Vav la mashma leh. (may kaamar rachamana — hameyuchadin shebbeshoftecha.) ella meatta: "veyatzu" — shenayim, "umaddu" — shenayim, lerabbi yehuda hare kan tisha, lerabbi shimon hare kan shiva!
Hahu, mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veyatzu" — hen velo sheluchehen, "umaddu" — sheafillu nimtza baalil lair hayu moddin, shemmitzva laasok bimdida.

Matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "zekenecha" — zo sanhedrin, "shoftecha" — ze melech vechohen gadol. melech — dichtiv: "melech bemishpat yaamid aretz", kohen gadol — dichtiv: "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye vegomer".
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bemelech vechohen gadol hu diflig, aval besanhedri, i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi shimon sevira leh, o dilma besanhedri name pelig, ad deikka kulla sanhedri?
Amar rav yosef, ta shema: metzaan zaken mamre abbe fagge vehimra alehen, yachol tehe hameraato hameraa — talmud lomar: "vekamta vealita el hammakom", melammed shehammakom gorem.
Dinfuk kamma? ilema dinfuk miktzatan, dilma hanach deikka gavvae kevoteh sevira lehu! ella peshita dinfuk kullehu.

Ulemay? i lidvar harshut — mi matzu nafki? vehachtiv: "shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg", sheim nitzrach echad mehem latzet, im yesh sham esrim ushelosha keneged sanhedri ketanna — yotze, veim lav — eno yotze.

Ella peshita lidvar mitzva. lemay? lav limdidat egla, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi? amar leh abbaye: la, dilma lehosif al hair veal haazarot. keditnan: en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bevet din shel shivim veechad.

Tanya kevoteh derav yosef: metzaan abbet pagge vehimra alehen, kegon sheyyatzu limdidat egla o lehosif al hair veal haazarot, yachol tehe hameraato hameraa — talmud lomar: "vekamta vealita", melammed shehammakom gorem.

Nimtza tamun baggal o taluy bailan. lema matnitin rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan. detanya: "veshachachta omer bassade" — perat letamun, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: "bassade" — lerabbot et hattamun.
Amar rav: afillu tema rabbanan, hacha meinyayneh dikra, hatam meinyayneh dikra.

Dichtiv: "ki yimmatze chalal" — hecha demishtechach, "baadama" — perat letamun. vehatam meinyayneh dikra — dichtiv: "ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer". shichcha dumeya dekatzir: ma katzir begaluy — af shichcha begaluy, ketav rachamana "bassade" — lerabbot et hattamun.
Lerabbi yehuda name, tippok leh mishshichcha dumeya dekatzir! in hachi name.
Veella "bassade", lema li? mibbee leh lerabbot shichchat kama. verabbanan shichchat kama mena lehu? nafka lehu mikki tiktzor ketzircha besadcha".

Verabbi yehuda mibbee leh lechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: perat leshetztzafu omarin letoch sede chavero. verabbanan: mibbassade" "besadecha". verabbi yehuda: "bassade" "besadecha" la mashma leh.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: tzafu omarin letoch sadehu, mahu? avir sade kesade dame, o lav kesade dame?

Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappe, veamri lah rav kahana lerav zevid: tifshot leh midderabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar, deamar: perat leshetztzafu omarin letoch sede chavero. dachavero — in, letoch sadehu — la.
Velitamaych: letoch sede chavero, tzafu — in, munnachin — la? veha baenan "besadecha", velekka!
Ella: letoch sede chavero, vaafillu munnachin. vehay dekaamar tzafu, dela mashkachat la ella betzafu.

Ta shema: omer shehechzik bo leholicho lair, vehinnicho al gabbe chavero, ushechacho — hattachton shichcha, vehaelyon eno shichcha. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: shenehem enan shichcha, hattachton mippene shehu tamun, vehaelyon mippene shehu tzaf. ad kan la peligi ella betachton, aval beelyon — divre hakkol la havey shichcha!
Shane hatam, kevan deachzek beh zecha beh. i hachi, may irya al gabbe chavero? afillu bassade name! in hachi name, vehay dekatane "al gabbe chavero", mishshum tachton.
Veha "mippene shehu tzaf" kaamar! ema: "mippene shehu ketzaf".
Amar abbaye: hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya. amar leh hahu midderabbanan leabbaye: shene chalalim ze al gabbe ze, mehechan hu moded?
Min bemino have tamun, umin bemino la have tzaf, umeelyon moded. o dilma: min bemino have tzaf, umin bemino la have tamun, umittachton moded.
O dilma: min bemino have tamun, umin bemino have tzaf, velo mittachton moded velo meelyon moded?
Amar leh:
b: Tenetuha: omer shehechzik bo leholicho lair, vehinnicho al gabbe chavero ushechacho — hattachton shichcha vehaelyon eno shichcha. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: shenehen enan shichcha, hattachton mippene shehu tamun, vehaelyon mippene shehu tzaf. savruha dehane tannae, kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu, deamar: "bassade" — perat letamun.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: min bemino have tamun, umar savar: la have tamun.
La, i kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu, dechulle alma min bemino have tamun, vehacha biflugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan kamippalgi, derabbanan kerabbanan. verabbi shimon ben yehuda kerabbi yehuda.
I hachi, may irya al gabbe chavero? afillu beafar uvitzror name! in hachi name, ulehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda, deamar: afillu min bemino have tamun.

Tanu rabbanan: "chalal" — velo chanuk, "chalal" — velo mefarper, "baadama" — velo tamun baggal, "nofel" — velo taluy bailan, "bassade" — velo tzaf al pene hammayim. rabbi elazar omer: bechullan, im haya chalal — orfin.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose bar yehuda: amru lo lerabbi elazar, i atta mode sheim haya chanuk umutal baashpa sheen orfin? alma: "chalal" — velo chanuk. hacha name: "baadama" — velo tamun baggal, "nofel" — velo taluy bailan, "bassade" — velo tzaf al gabbe mayim. verabbi elazar: "chalal" yattira ketiv.
Nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sherubbah nochrim kulei. dichtiv: "ki yimmatze" — perat lematzuy.
O leir sheen bah bet din. devaena "zikne hair", velekka. en moddin ella leir kulei. peshita! kevan ditna leir sheen bah bet din, ana yadana deen moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din!
Ha ka mashma lan kidtanya: minnayin sheim nimtza samuch leir sheen bah bet din, shemmannichin otah umoddin leir sheyyesh bah bet din — talmud lomar: "velakchu zikne hair hahi" — mikkol makom.

Mishna nimtza mechuuon ben shete ayayrot — shetehen meviot shete agalot, divre rabbi eliezer. veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa. nimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher — molichin harosh etzel hagguf, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer: hagguf etzel harosh. meayin hayu moddin? rabbi eliezer omer: mittibburo, rabbi akiva omer: mechotmo, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mimmakom shennaase chalal, mitztzavvaro.
Gemara may tama derabbi eliezer — kasavar efshar letzamtzem, ukerova", vaafillu kerovot.
Veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa — deamar kera "lerishtah", vekasavar: yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim.

Nimtza rosho bemakom kulei. bemay kamippalgi? illema leinyan medida kamippalgi, ha middekatane sefa "meayin hayu moddin", mikkelal deresha la bimdida askinan! amar rabbi yitzchak: bemet mitzva kana mekomo kamippalgi,

Vehachi kaamar: lekovro kana mekomo, vehecha denimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher — molichin harosh etzel hagguf, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer: hagguf etzel harosh. bemay kamippalgi — mar savar: gufeh beducheteh nafel, resha denade venafel, umar savar: resha hecha denafel nafel, gufa hu derahet azel.
Meayin hayu moddin. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: ikkar chiyyuta beappeh, umar savar: ikkar chiyyuta betibbureh.

Lema ki hane tannae: mehechan havvalad notzar — merosho, vechen hu omer: "mimmee immi atta gozi", veomer: "gozzi nizrech vehashelichi vegomer". abba shaul omer: mittibburo, umeshalleach shorsho elach.

Afillu tema abba shaul, ad kan la kaamar abba shaul ella leinyan yetzira, dechi mittetzar velad mimmetziateh mittetzar, aval leinyan chiyyuta — dechulle alma beappeh hu, dichtiv: "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav vegomer".
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mimmakom shennaase chalal — mitztzavvaro. may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov? kedichtiv: "latet otach el tzavvere challe reshaim".

Mishna nifteru zikne yerushalayim vehalchu lahen. zikne otah hair meviin eglat bakar asher lo mashcha beol, veen hammum posel bah, umoridin otah lenachal etan. "etan" kemashmao: kashe. af al pi sheeno etan — kasher. veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha. umekomah asur millizroa umillaavod, umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulenakker sham avanim.

Zikne otah hair rochatzin et yedehen bammayim bimkom arifa shel egla, veomrim "yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau". vechi al datenu alta shezzikne bet din shofche damim hen? ella shello ba al yadenu ufetarnuhu (belo mazon), velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu (belo levayay).

a: Vehakkohanim omrim: "kapper leammecha yisrael asher padita Adonai veal titten dam naki bekerev ammecha yisrael". lo hayu tzerichin lomar "venikkapper lahem haddam", ella ruach hakkodesh mevassartan: ematay shettaasu kacha — haddam mitkapper lahem.

Gemara vihe mum posel beegla mikkal vachomer: uma para sheen hashshanim poslot bah, mum posel bah, egla sheshshanim poslot bah — eno din sheyyehe mum posel bah! shane hatam deamar kera: "asher en bah mum" — bah mum posel, veen mum posel beegla.
Ella meatta lo yehu shear avodot poslot bah.
Allema amar rav yehuda amar rav: hinniach aleha udda shel sakkin — pesula, uveegla ad shettimshoch! shane para, deyalfinan "ol" "ol" meegla.
Egla name tete "ol" "ol" mippara! ha mayet rachamana "bah".

Beegla name ketiv "bah"! hahu mibbee leh lemaote kodashim, dela pasla behu avoda. salka datach amena lete bekal vachomer meegla: uma egla sheen mum posel bah — avoda poselet bah, kodashim shemmum posel(400) bahen — eno din sheavoda poselet bahen?
Ikka lemifrach: ma leegla shekken shanim poslot bah! attu kodashim mi lekka defasli behu shanim? ki itzterich kera lehanach kodashim defasli behu shanim.

Vekadashim dela pasla behu avoda mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "avveret o shavur o charutz o yabbelet o garav o yallefet lo takrivu elle laAdonai", elle i atta makriv, aval atta makriv kodashim shenneevda bahen avoda! itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille hecha deavad bahen avodat hetter, aval avodat issur ema littasru, tzericha.
Veha name mehacha nafka — "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem mikkol elle", elle i atta makriv, aval atta makriv kodashim shenneevda bahen avoda!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille hecha deavad bahen keshehen chullin, aval avad bahen keshehen kodashim — ema littasru, tzericha.

Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav: hinniach aleha udda shel sakkin pesula, uveegla ad shettimshoch. metivi: "ol", en li ella ol, shear avodot minnayin? amarta, kal vachomer: uma egla sheen mum posel bah, shear avodot poslot bah, para shemmum posel bah — eno din sheshshear avodot poslin bah?
Veim nafshecha lomar: neemar kan "ol" veneemar lehallan "ol". ma lehallan shear avodot poslot bah — af kan shear avodot poslot.
May "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema, ikka lemifrach: ma leegla shekken shanim poslot bah. i name: kodashim yochichu, shemmum posel bahen, veen avoda poselet bahen.
Neemar kan "ol" veneemar lehallan "ol", ma lehallan shear avodot — af kan shear avodot. umimmakom shebbata: ma lehallan ad shettimshoch, af kan ad shettimshoch!
Tannae hi, deikka demayyte la meegla, ikka demayyte la miggufa defara.

Detanya: "ol", en li ella ol. shear avodot minnayin — talmud lomar: "asher lo ala aleha ol" mikkol makom. im ken ma talmud lomar "ol" — ol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda, shear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda.
Veema: "asher lo ala aleha" — kalal, "ol" — parat, kelal uferat, en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat: ol in, midde acharina — la! "asher" — ribbuya hu.

Vetanya name gabbe egla ki hay gavvna: "ol", en li ella ol. shear avodot minnayin — talmud lomar: "asher lo ubbad bah" mikkol makom. im ken ma talmud lomar "ol" — ol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda, shear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda.
Veema: "asher lo ubbad bah" — kalal, "ol" — parat. kelal uferat, en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat: ol — in, midde acharina — la! "asher" — ribbuya hu.

Amar rabbi avahu, beay minneh merabbi yochanan: meshichat ol bechamma? amar li: kimlo ol. ibbaya lehu: leorko o lerochbo? amar lehu hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan: meshichat ol lerochbo tefach.
Velema tefach? ha ka mashma lan shiura deol — tefach have. lemay nafka minna — lemikkach umimkar.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben shaul, mippene ma amra tora: have egla benachal? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo davar shello asa perot, veyearef bimkom sheen ose perot, vichapper al mi shello hinnichu[hu] laasot perot. may perot? ilema periyya ureviyya — ella meatta azzaken veassaris hachi name dela arfinan?! ella mitzvot.
Umoridin otah el nachal etan. "etan" kemashmao, kashe. tanu rabbanan: minnayin leetan shehu kashe — shenneemar:
b: "Etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha", veomer: "shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz". acherim omrim: minnayin leetan" shehu yashan — shenneemar: "goy etan hu, goy meolam hu".
"Veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha". may tama — gamar arifa arifa mechattat haof.
"Umekomah, asur millizroa umilleaved". tanu rabbanan: "asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea" — lesheavar, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: lehabba.

Rava amar: lehabba — dechulle alma la peligi, dichtiv: "velo yizzarea", ki peligi lesheavar. rabbi yoshiyya savar: mi ketiv "velo yeubbad"? verabbi yonatan: mi ketiv "asher lo neevad"? verabbi yoshiyya: "asher" — lesheavar mashma, verabbi yonatan: "asher" — ribbuya hu.
Umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulenakker sham avanim. tanu rabbanan: "asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea" — en li ella zeria, shear avodot minnayin? talmud lomar: "asher lo yeaved bo" — mikkol makom.
Im ken ma talmud lomar "velo yizzarea"? lomar lecha: ma zeria meyuchedet shehi begufah shel karka, af kol shehu begufah shel karka. yatza serikat pishtan venikkur avanim, sheenan begufah shel karka.
Veema: "asher lo yeaved bo" — kalal, "velo yizzarea" — parat. kelal uferat, en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat: zeria — in, midde acharina — la! "asher" — ribbuya hu.

Zikne hair rochatzin yedehen kulei. tanu rabbanan: "vechol zikne hair hahi hakkerovim el hechalal yirchatzu et yedehem al haegla haarufa vannachal". sheen talmud lomar "haarufa", uma talmud lomar "haarufa" — al mekom arifatah shel egla.
"Veamru yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau", vechi al libbenu alta shebbet din shofchin damim?! ella: lo ba leyadenu ufetarnuhu belo mezonot, velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu belo levaya.

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kofin lilvaya, shessechar halevaya en lah shiur, shenneemar: "vayyiru hashshomrim ish yotze min hair vayyomru lo hareenu na et mevo hair veasinu immecha chased", uchetiv: "vayyarem et mevo hair", uma chesed asu immo — shekkol otah hair hargu lefi cherev, veoto haish umishpachto shalchu.

"Vayyelech haish eretz hachittim vayyiven ir vayyikra shemah luz hu shemah ad hayyom hazze", tanya: hi luz shetztzovin bah techelet, hi luz shebba sancheriv velo bilbelah, nevuchadnetztzar velo hechrivah, veaf malach hammavet en lo reshut laavor bah. ella zekenim shebbah, bizman sheddatan katza alehen yotzin chutz lachoma, vehen metim.
Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma kenaani ze shello dibber befiv, velo halach beraglav — garam hatztzala lo ulezaro ad sof kol haddorot, mi sheose levaya beraglav — al achat kamma vechamma.

Bamma hera lahem? chizkiyya amar: befiv ikkem lahem, rabbi yochanan amar: beetzbao hera lahem. tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: bishvil shekkenaani ze hera beetzbao, garam hatztzala lo ulezaro ad sof kol haddorot.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hamehallech badderech veen lo levaya — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "ki livyat chen hem leroshecha vaanakim legargerotecha". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bishvil arbaa pesiot shellivva paro leavraham, shenneemar: "vaytzav alav paro anashim vegomer", nishtabed bevanav arba meot shana — shenneemar: "vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana". amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hamelavve et chavero arba ammot bair — eno nizzok. ravina alveye lerava bar yitzchak arba ammot bair, meta lideh hezzeka veittatztzil.

Tanu rabbanan: harav letalmid — ad ibburah shel ir, chaver lechaver — ad techum shabbat, talmid lerav — en lo shiur. vechamma? amar rav sheshet: ad parsa. vela amaran ella rabbo sheeno muvehak, aval rabbo muvehak — shelosha parsaot.
Rav kahana alveye lerav shimi bar ashe mippum nahara ad be tzinyata devavel. ki meto hatam amar leh: vadday deamritu hane tzinyata devavel mishshene adam harishon itanhu?

Amar leh: adkartan milleta deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "beeretz lo avar bah ish velo yashav adam sham"? vechi meachar shello avar — hechan yashav (umeachar shello yashav — hechan avar)? ella: eretz sheggazar aleha adam harishon leyishshuv — nityashsheva, eretz shello gazar aleha adam harishon — lo nityashsheva.
Rav mardochay alveye lerav ashe mehageronya vead be chefe, veamri la: ad be dura.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: kol sheeno melavve umitlavve — keillu shofech damim, sheilmale liuuhu anshe yericho leelisha lo gera dubbim lattinokot, shenneemar: "vayyaal mishsham bet el vehu ole vadderech unearim ketannim yatzu min hair vayyitkallesu vo vayyomru lo ale kereach ale kereach".

Amru lo: ale, shehikrachta alenu et hammakom. may "unearim ketannim"? amar rabbi elazar: shemmenoarim min hammitzvot, "ketannim" — shehayu mikketanne amana. tana: nearim hayu, uvizbezu atzman kiktannim.

Matkef la rav yosef: vedilma al shem mekoman? mi la ketiv "vaaram yatzu gedudim vayyishbu meeretz yisrael naara ketanna", vekashya lan: "naara" uketanna"? veamar rabbi pedat: ketanna demin neoran! hatam la mefarash mekomah, hacha meforash mekoman.

"Vayyifen acharav vayyirem vaykallem beshem Adonai". ma raa? amar rav: raa mammash. kidtanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem — o mita, o oni. ushemuel amar: raa shekkullan nitabbera bahen imman beyom hakkippurim.

Verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: belorit raa lahen, kegoyim. verabbi yochanan amar: raa shello hayta bahen lachluchit shel mitzva. vedilma bezarayyhu niAdonai hava? amar rabbi elazar: lo bam velo bezaram ad sof kol haddorot.
"Vattetzena shetayim dubbim min hayyaar vattevakkana mehem arbaim ushene yeladim",

a: Rav ushemuel, chad amar: nes. vechad amar: nes betoch nes. man deamar nes — yaar hava, dubbim la havo. man deamar nes betoch nes — lo yaar hava vela dubbim havo. velihve dubbim vela leheve yaar! diviti.
Amar rabbi chanina: bishvil arbaim ushenayim korbanot shehikriv balak melech moav huveku miyyisrael arbaim ushenayim yeladim. ini?

Vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot, veaf al pi shello lishmah. shemmittoch shello lishmah — ba lishmah. shebbischar arbaim ushenayim korbanot shehikriv balak melech moav, zacha veyatzta mimmennu rut sheyyatza mimmenna shelomo, shekkatuv beh "elef olot yaale shelomo". veamar rabbi yose ben choni: rut bitto shel eglon beno shel balak hayta! taavato miha liklala heve.

"Vayyomru anshe hair el elisha hinne na moshav hair tov kaasher adoni roe vegomer". vechi meachar demayim raim veeretz meshakkelet, ella ma tovatah? amar rabbi chanin: chen makom al yoshvav. amar rabbi yochanan, shelosha chinnot hen: chen makom al yoshvav, chen ishsha al balah, chen mikkach al (mikkacho).

Tanu rabbanan, shelosha chalain chala elisha: echad sheggera dubbim battinokot, veechad sheddechafo legechazi bishte yadayim, veechad shemmet bo, shenneemar: "veelisha chala et cholyo asher yamut bo".
Tanu rabbanan: leolam tehe semol docha veyamin mekarevet, lo keelisha sheddechafo legechazi bishte yadav, velo kihoshua ben perachya sheddechafo leyeshu hannotzri mittalmidav bishte yadav.

Elisha may hi, dichtiv: "vayyomer naaman hoel kach kikkarayim", uchetiv: "vayyomer elav lo libbi halach kaasher hafach ish meal merkavto likratecha haet lakachat et hakkesef velakachat begadim vezetim ucheramim vetzon uvakar vaavadim ushefachot".

Umi shakel kulle hay? kesef uvegadim hu deshakel! amar rabbi yitzchak: beotah shaa haya elisha osek bishmona sheratzim, amar lo: rasha, higgia et littol sechar shemona sheratzim. "vetzaraat naaman tidbak becha uvezaracha leolam". "vearbaa anashim hayu metzoraim", amar rabbi yochanan: ze gechazi usheloshet banav.

"Vayyavo elisha dammesek". lamma halach? amar rabbi yochanan: shehalach lehacheziro legechazi bitshuva, velo chazar. amar lo: chazor bach. amar lo: kach mekubbelani mimmecha, kol mi shechata vehechti et harabbim — en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva.
May avad? ikka deamri: even shoevet tala lo lechattat yaravam, veheemido ben shamayim laaretz. veikka deamri: shem chakak la appumma, vehayta omeret "anochi" velo yihye lecha".
Veikka deamri: rabbanan decha mikkammeh, dichtiv: "vayyomru vene hanneviim el elisha hinne na hammakom asher anachnu yoshvim sham lefanecha tzar mimmennu", mikkelal dead haiddana la hava dechik.

Yehoshua ben perachya may hi — kedahava ka katel yannay malka lerabbanan, shimon ben shatach (atminehu) [atmarteh] achateh, rabbi yehoshua ben perachya azal arak laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. ki hava shelama, shelach leh shimon ben shatach: minnay yerushalayim ir hakkodesh lich alekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim: achoti! baali sharuy betochech, vaani yoshevet shomema! amar: shema minna hava leh shelama.

Ki ata, ikkela lehahu ushepiza, kam kammayyhu bikara shappir, avdi leh yekara tuva, yatev veka mishtabbach: kamma naa achsanya zo! amar leh yeshu hannotzri: rabbi, eneha terutot. amar leh: rasha, bechach atta osek? appek arba mea shippure veshammeteh. kol yoma ata lekammeh vela kabbeleh.

Yoma chad hava kare keriyyat shema, ata lekammeh. hava bedateh lekabboleh, achvi leh bideh, sevar midcha dache leh, azal zekaf leventa palcha. amar leh: chazor bach! amar leh: kach mekubbelani mimmecha, kol hachote umachti et harabbim — en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. deamar mar: yeshu hannotzri kishshef vehissit vehiddiach vehechti et yisrael.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: yetzer, tinok, veishsha — tehe semol docha veyamin mekarevet.

Mishna nimtza hahoreg ad shello neerfa haegla — tetze vetire baeder. mishshenneerfa haegla — tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek bata mittechillatah — kippera sefekah, vehalcha lah. neerfa haegla veachar kach nimtza hahoreg — hare ze yehareg.

Ed echad omer "raiti et hahoreg", veed echad omer "lo raita". ishsha omeret "raiti", veishsha omeret "lo rait" — hayu orfin. ed echad omer "raiti", ushenayim omrim "lo raita" — hayu orfin. shenayim omrim "rainu", veechad omer lahen "lo reitem" — lo hayu orfin.
Mishsherabbu harotzchanin — batla egla arufa. mishshebba eliezer ben dinay, utechinna ben perisha haya nikra, chazru likroto "ben haratzchan".
Mishsherabbu hamenaafim — pasku hammayim hammarim. verabbi yochanan ben zakkay hifsikan, shenneemar: "lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena veal kallotechem ki tenaafna ki hem vegomer".

Mishshemmet yose ben yoezer ish tzereda veyose ben yehuda ish yerushalayim batlu haeshkolot, shenneemar: "en eshkol leechol bikkura ivveta nafshi", yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayayt hammaaser. af hu bittel et hameorrin veet hannokfin.
b: Ad yamav haya pattish makke birushalayim. uveyamav en tzarich lishol al haddemay.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim neerfa haegla veachar kach nimtza hahoreg sheen poteret oto — talmud lomar: "velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah ki im bedam shofcho".
Ed echad omer raiti et hahoreg kulei. tama demachchesh leh, ha la machchesh leh — ed echad meheman.

Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "lo noda mi hikkahu". ha noda mi hikkahu, afillu echad besof haolam — lo hayu orfin. rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lesanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh veen makkirin oto, shello hayu orfin — talmud lomar: "veenenu lo rau", vahalo rau.

Hasheta deamrat ed echad meheman, iddach chad hechi matze machchesh leh? vehaamar ulla: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hare kan shenayim, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim! amar lach ulla, teni: "lo hayu orfin". vechen amar rabbi yitzchak, teni: "lo hayu orfin".
Verabbi chiyyay amar, teni: "hayu orfin". ulerabbi chiyyay kashya deulla! la kashya: kan bevat achat, kan beze achar ze.
Tenan: ed echad omer "raiti et hahoreg", ushenayim omrim "lo raita" — hayu orfin. ha chad vechad — lo hayu orfin, teyuveta derabbi chiyyay!
Velitamaych, ema sefa: shenayim omrim "rainu", veed echad omer "lo reitem" — lo hayu orfin. ha chad vechad — hayu orfin.
Ella: matnitin kulla bifsule edut, vechidrabbi nechemya, deamar: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad.

Veikka deamri: kol hecha daata ed echad — kasher meikkara, afillu mea nashim ki echad damyayn. vehacha bemay askinan — kegon daatay ishsha meikkara. vetartza lidrabbi nechemya hachi: rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beishsha achat kishne anashim beish echad, aval shete nashim beish echad — ki palga ufalga dame.
Vetarte pesule edut, lema li? mahu detema: ki azlinan batar rov deot — lechumera, aval lekulla — la, ka mashma lan.
Mishsherabbu harotzchin kulei. tanu rabbanan: mishsherabbu harotzchanin — batla egla arufa, lefi sheenah baa ella al hassafek. mishsherabbu harotzchanin begaluy — batla egla arufa.

Mishsherabbu hannoafin kulei. tanu rabbanan: "venikka haish meavon", bizman shehaish menukke meavon — hammayim bodkin et ishto, en haish menukke meavon — en hammayim bodkin et ishto. veomer: "lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena kulei".
May "veomer"? vechi tema avon dideh — in, divneh vedivnateh — la, ta shema: "lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena veal kallotechem ki tenaafna".
Vechi tema: avon eshet ish — in, avon difnuya — la, ta shema: "ki hem im hazzonot yefaredu veim hakkedeshot yezabbechu vegomer".
May "veam lo yavin yillavet"? amar rabbi elazar: amar lahem navi leyisrael: im attem makpidin al atzmechem — mayim bodkin neshotechem, veim lav — en hammayim bodkin neshotechem.

Mishsherabbu baale hanaa, nitavvetu haddinin venitkalkelu hammaasim veen noach baolam. mishsherabbu roe fanim baddin, batal "lo taguru", ufasak "lo takkiru", ufarku ol shamayim venatnu alehem ol basar vadam.

Mishsherabbu lochashe lechishot baddin — rava charon af beyisrael, venistalleka hashshechina, mishshum shenneemar: "bekerev elohim yishpot". mishsherabbu "achare vitzam libbam holech" — rabbu "haomrim lara tov velattov ra". mishsherabbu "haomrim lara tov velattov ra" — rabbu "hoy hoy" baolam.

Mishsherabbu moshche harok — rabbu hayyehirim venitmaatu hattalmidim, vehattora chozeret al lomdeha. mishsherabbu hayyehirim — hitchilu benot yisrael lehinnase lihirim, sheen dorenu roe ella lappanim.
Ini?! vehaamar mar: hay man demiyyahar — afillu ainashe beteh la mikkabbal, shenneemar: "gever yahir velo yinve", lo yinve afillu bannave shello! meikkara kaftza aleh, lesof mittezil alayyhu.

Mishsherabbu mattile melay al baale vattim — rava hashshochad vehattayayt mishpat, ufaska tova. mishsherabbu "mekabbeleni tovatcha" umechazzekeni tovotecha" — rabbu "ish hayyashar beenav yaase". shefalim hugebhu, vehaggevohim husheplu, umalchuta azla venavla. mishsherabbu tzare ayin vetorfe teref — rabbu meammetze hallev vekoftze yadayim millehalvot, veavru al ma shekkatuv battora "hishshamer lecha pen vegomer".

Mishsherabbu "netuyot garon umesakkerot enayim" — rabbu mayim hammarim, ella sheppasku. mishsherabbu mekabbele mattanot — nitmaatu hayyamim venitkatztzeru hashshanim, dichtiv: "vesone mattanot yichye". mishsherabbu zechuche hallev — rabbu machalokot beyisrael. mishsherabbu talmide shammay vehillel shello shimmeshu kol tzorkan — rabbu machlokot beyisrael, venaaset tora kishte torot. mishsherabbu mekabbele tzedaka min hannochri — hayu yisrael lemala vehem lematta, yisrael lifnim vehem leachor.

Mishshemmet yose ben yoezer kulei. may "eshkolot"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, ish shehakkol bo. yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayayt hammaaser kulei. may tama? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lefi sheen notnin oto ketikkuno. derachamana amar deyahavi lilviyyim,

a: Vaanan ka yahavinan lechohanim.
Velode ashshear maasrot? amar resh lakish: kol bayit sheen mitvadde al maaser rishon — shuv en mitvadde al shear maasrot. may tama? amar abbaye: hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla.

Michlal deafroshe havo mafreshi? veha tanya: af hu bittel et havvidduy, vegazar al haddemay. lefi sheshshalach bechol gevul yisrael veraa sheen mafrishin ella teruma gedola bilvad, umaaser rishon umaaser sheni — miktzatan measserin umiktzatan en measserin.
Amar lahem: banay, bou veomar lachem: keshem shetteruma gedola yesh bah avon mita — kach terumat maaser vetevel yesh bahen avon mita.

Amad vehitkin lahem: hallokeach perot meam haaretz — mafrish mehen maaser rishon umaaser sheni. maaser rishon — mafrish mimmenna terumat maaser venotnah lechohen, umaaser sheni ole veochlo birushalayim. maaser rishon umasar ani — hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Tarte takken: bittel vidduy dachaverim, vegazar al demay shel amme haaretz.

Veaf hu bittel et hameorrim. may meorrim? amar rachava: bechol yom vayom shehayu omdim leviyyim al duchan veomrim "ura lamma tishan Adonai", amar lahen: vechi yesh shena lifne hammakom? vahalo kevar neemar "hinne lo yanum velo yishan shomer yisrael"! ella bizman sheyyisrael sheruyin betzaar veummot haolam benachat veshalva, lechach neemar "ura lamma tishan Adonai".
Veet hannokfim. may "nokfim"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shehayu mesartin laegel ben karnav, kede sheyyippol dam beenav. ata ihu battel, mishshum demichaze ki muma.

Bematnita tana: shehayu chovtin oto bemaklot kederech sheosin oto lifne avoda zara. amar lahem: ad matay attem maachilin nevelot lammizbeach! nevelot?! ha shachet lehu! ella terefot — shemma nikkav kerum shel moach. amad vehitkin lahem tabbaot bakkarka.
Ad yamav haya pattish makke birushalayim. bechullo shel moed.
Kol yamav lo haya adam tzarich lishol al haddemay. kedaamaran.
Mishna mishshebbatla sanhedrin — batal hashshir mibbet hammishtaot, shenneemar: "bashshir lo yishtu yayin vegomer".

Mishshemmetu neviim harishonim — batlu urim vetummim. mishshecharav bet hammikdash — batal hashshamir venofet tzufim, ufasku anshe amana miyyisrael, shenneemar: "hoshia Adonai ki gamar chasid vegomer".

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, heid rabbi yehoshua: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en yom sheen bo kelala, velo yarad hattal livracha, venittal taam happerot. rabbi yose omer: af nittal shomen happerot. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hattohora natla et hattaam veet hareach, hammaasrot natlu et shomen haddagan. vachachamim omrim: hazzenut vehakkeshafim kilu et hakkol.
Gemara umimmay demishshebbatla sanhedri ketiv? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, deamar kera: "zekenim mishshaar shavatu bachurim minneginatam".
Amar rav: udena deshama zimra — tiakar. amar rava: zimra beveta — chureba besippa, shenneemar: "kol yeshorer bachallon chorev bassaf ki arza era".

May "ki arza era"? amar rabbi yitzchak: bayit hamesubbach baarazim ir hu! ella: afillu bayit hamesubbach baarazim mitroea. amar rav ashe: shema minna ki matchel chureba — besippa matchel, shenneemar: "chorev bassaf". veibbaet ema mehacha: "usheiyya yukkat shaar". amar mar bar rav ashe: ledidi chaze li umenaggach ki tora.

Amar rav huna: zimra denaggade udevakkare — shere. degardae — asir. rav huna battel zimra, kam mea avoze bezuza umea sae chitte bezuza vela ibbei. ata rav chisda zalzel beh, ibbeay avoza bezuza vela ishtechach.
Amar rav yosef: zamri gavre veonya[yn] neshe — peritzuta. (zamri) [zamran] neshe veanayi[yn] gavre — keesh binoret. lemay nafka minna — levattole ha mikkamme ha.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hashshote bearbaa mine zemer, mevi chamesh pureaniyyot leolam, shenneemar: "hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu meachare vanneshef yayin yadlikem vehaya chinnor vanevel tof vechalil vayayin mishtehem veet poal Adonai lo yabbitu",

Ma ketiv acharav: "lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat" — sheggormin galut laolam, "uchevodo mete raav" — shemmeviin raav leolam, "vahamono tziche tzama" — sheggormin lattora shettishtakkach millomdeha, "vayyishshach adam vayyishpal ish" — sheggormin shiflut lesono shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veen "ish" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama", "veene gevohim tishpalna" — sheggormin shiflut shel yisrael.
Uma ketiv acharav — "lachen
b: Hirchiva sheol nafshah ufaara fiha livli chok veyarad hadarah vahamonah usheonah vealez bah".

Mishshemmetu neviim harishonim. man "neviim harishonim"? amar rav huna: ze david ushemuel ushelomo. rav nachman amar: bime david, zimnin selek, vezimnin la selek, shehare shaal tzadok — vealta lo, shaal evyatar — velo alta lo, shenneemar: "vayyaal evyatar".
Metiv rabba bar shemuel: "vayhi lidrosh elohim bime zecharyahu hammevin birot haelohim", may lav, beurim vetummim? lo, binviim.
Ta shema: mishshecharav bet hammikdash rishon batlu are migrash, ufasku urim vetummim, ufasak melech mibbet david.

Veim lechashcha adam lomar: "vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim ad amod kohen leurim uletummim", emor lo: keadam sheomer lachavero "ad sheyyichyu metim veyavo mashiach ben david".

Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man "neviim harishonim" — leappoke mechaggay zecharya umalachi, deacharonim ninhu. detanu rabbanan: mishshemmetu chaggay zecharya umalachi — nistalleka ruach hakkodesh miyyisrael. veaf al pi chen, hayu mishtammeshim bevat kol,

Sheppaam achat hayu mesubbin baaliyyayt bet gureya biricho, nittena alehen bat kol min hashshamayim veamra: yesh bachem adam echad sherauy shettishre shechina alav, ella sheen doro rauy lechach. natnu enehem behillel hazzaken, ucheshemmet hispiduhu: hi chasid, hi anav, talmido shel ezra.

Veshuv paam acheret hayu mesubbin baaliyyay beyavne, nittena (lahen) [alehen] bat kol min hashshamayim, veamra lahen: yesh bachem adam echad sherauy shettishre shechina alav ella sheen doro zakkain lechach, natnu enehem bishmuel hakkatan. ucheshemmet, hispiduhu: hi anav, hi chasid, talmido shel hillel.

Veaf hu amar bishat mitato: shimon veyishmael — lecharba, vechavrohi — liktala, ushear amma — levizza, veakan saggiin atidin lemete al amma. veaf al rabbi yehuda ben bava bikkeshu lomar "hi chasid hi anav", ella shennitrefa shaa, sheen maspidin al haruge malchut.

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash batal hashshamir kulei. tanu rabbanan: shamir shebbo bana shelomo et bet hammikdash, shenneemar: "vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema massa nivna" — haddevarim kichtavan, divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi efshar lomar ken? vahalo kevar neemar "kol elle avanim yekarot vegomer megorarot bammegera"! im ken ma talmud lomar "lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto" — shehaya metakken mibbachutz, umachnis mibbifnim. amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda beavne mikdash, vedivre rabbi nechemya beavne veto.

Verabbi nechemya, shamir lemay ata? mibbee leh lechidtanya: avanim hallalu en kotvin otan bidyo, mishshum shenneemar: "pittuche chotam", veen mesartin alehem beizmel, mishshum shenneemar: "bemilluotam",

Ella kotev alehem bidyo, umare lahen shamir mibbachutz, vehen nivkaot mealehen, kitena zo shennivkaat bimot hachamma veenah chasera kelum, uchevika zo, shennivkaat bimot haggeshamim, veenah chasera kelum.

Tanu rabbanan: shamir ze, beriyyayto kisora, umishsheshet yeme bereshit nivra, veen kol davar kashe yachol laamod befanav. bamme meshammerin oto — korchin oto bisfogin shel tzemer, umannichin oto beitni shel avar melea subbe seorin.

Amar rabbi amme: mishshecharav mikdash rishon — batla shira peranda uzechuchit levana. tanya name hachi: mishshecharav mikdash rishon — batla shira peranda uzechuchit levana verechev barzel, veyesh omrim: af yayin karush habba missenir, haddome keiggule devela.

Venofet tzufim. may "nofet tzufim"? amar rav: solet shetztzafa al gabbe nafa, vedoma leissa shennillosha bidvash vashemen. velevi amar: shete kikkarot hannidbakot battannur vetofchot uvaot, ad shemmaggiot zo lazo. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: ze devash habba min hatztzifya. may mashma — kedimtargem rav sheshet: "kema denatzan davrayata veshayytan berume alma umatyayn duvesha meisve tura".

Tenan hatam: kol hannitztzok tahor, chutz middevash zifim vehatzappichim. may "zifim"? amar rabbi yochanan: devash shemmezayyeyfin bo. veresh lakish amar: al shem mekomo, kedichtiv: "zif vatelem uvealot".

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "bevo hazzifim vayyomru leshaul halo david vegomer". may "zifim"? amar rabbi yochanan: bene adam hamezayyeyfin divrehem. verabbi elazar omer: al shem mekoman, kedichtiv: "zif vatelem uvealot".

Ufasku anshe amana. amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu bene adam shehen maaminin behakkadosh baruch hu. detanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: kol mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo veomer "ma ochal lemachar" — eno ella mikketanne amana.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: may dichtiv "ki mi vaz leyom ketannot" — mi garam latztzaddikim sheyyitbazbez shulechanan leatid lavo — katnut shehaya bahen, shello heeminu behakkadosh baruch hu, rava amar: ellu ketanne bene rishe yisrael,

a: Shemmevazbezin din avihem leatid lavo. omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, meachar sheatta atid lippara mehen, lama hikheta shinnehem bam?

Amar rabbi ila bar yeverechya: ilmale tefillato shel david, hayu kol yisrael mochre revav, shenneemar: "shita Adonai mora lahem". veamar rabbi ila bar yeverechya: ilmale tefillato shel chavakkuk, hayu shene talmide chachamim mitkassim betallit achat veoskin battora, shenneemar: "Adonai shamati shimacha yareti Adonai poolcha bekerev shanim chayyehu". al tikra "bekerev shanim", ella "bekeruv shenayim".

Veamar rabbi ila bar yeverechya: shene talmide chachamim hamehallechin badderech veen benehen divre tora — reuyin lissaref baesh, shenneemar: "vayhi hemma holchim haloch vedabber vehinne rechev esh vegomer", tama deikka dibbur, ha lekka dibbur — reuyin lissaref.

Veamar rabbi ila bar yeverechya: shene talmide chachamim haddarin beir achat veen nochin ze laze bahalacha — echad met veechad gole, shenneemar: "lanus shamma rotzeach asher yirtzach et reehu bivli daat", veen daat ella tora, shenneemar: "nidmu ammi mibbeli haddaat".

Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: kol talmid chacham haosek battora mittoch haddechak — tefillato nishmaat, shenneemar: "ki am betziyyon yeshev birushalam bacho lo tivke chanon yochnecha lekol zaakecha keshomato anach", uchetiv batreh: "venatan Adonai lachem lechem tzar umayim lachatz".
Rabbi avahu omer: masbiin oto mizziv shechina, shenneemar: "vehayu enecha root et morecha". rabbi acha bar chanina amar: af en happargod ninal befanav, shenneemar: "velo yikkanef od morecha".

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en vechulei. amar rava: bechol yom vayom merubba killato mishshel chavero, shenneemar: "babboker tomar mi yitten erev uvaerev tomar mi yitten boker", he boker? ilema boker delimchar, mi yada may have? ella dachalef.
Veella, alma ammay ka mikkayyaym? akkedushsha desidra, veayyehe shemeh rabba" deaggadta, shenneemar: "eretz efata kemo ofel tzalmavet velo sedarim", ha yesh sedarim — tofia meofel.
Velo yarad tal livracha venittal taam perot vechulei. tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: tohora — bittela taam vareach, maaser — bittel shomen dagan.

Rav huna ashkach tomarta dechinunita, shakla, karcha besudareh. ata rabba bereh, amar leh: morchina recha dechinunita. amar leh: beni, tohora yesh becha. yahava nihaleh. addehachi ata abba bereh, shakla, yahava nihaleh. amar leh: beni, simmachta et libbi, vehikheta et shinnay. hayeynu deamri inashe: rachame deabba — abbene, rachame divne — abbene dehavu leh.
Rav acha bar yaakov ittappal beh berav yaakov bar beratte. ki gedal amar leh: ashkeyayn mayya. amar lo: lav beraych ana. vehayeynu deamri inashe: rabbi rabbi, bar berattach ana.
Mishna befulemus shel aspasyaynus gazru al atrot chatanim veal hairus.
Befulemus shel titus gazru al atrot kallot, veshello yelammed adam et beno yevonit.
Befulemus haacharon gazru shello tetze hakkalla beappiryon betoch hair, verabbotenu hittiru shettetze hakkalla beappiryon betoch hair.

Mishshemmet rabbi meir batlu moshle meshalim. mishshemmet ben azzay batlu hashshakdanim. mishshemmet ben zoma batlu haddarshanim. mishshemmet rabbi akiva batal kevod hattora. mishshemmet rabbi chanina ben dosa batlu anshe maase. mishshemmet rabbi yose ketonta pasku chasidim. velamma nikra shemo "ketonta" — shehaya ketonta shel chasidim.

Mishshemmet rabban yochanan ben zakkay batal ziv hachochma. mishshemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken batal kevod hattora, umeta tohora uferishut. mishshemmet rabbi yishmael ben piavi batla ziv hakkehunna. mishshemmet rabbi batla[5] anava veyirat chet.

[Gemara] tanu rabbanan: rabbi pinchas ben yair omer: mishshecharav bet hammikdash boshu chaverim uvene chorin, vechafu rosham, veniddaldelu anshe maase, vegavru baale zeroa uvaale lashon, veen doresh veen mevakkesh veen shoel,
Al mi lanu lehishshaen al avinu shebbashshamayim.
Rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash sharo chakkimayya lemeheve kesafrayya, vesafrayya kechazzanayya, vechazzanayya keamma deara, veamma deara
b: Azla (vedaldalah) [venavvla], veen shoel veen mevakkesh. al mi yesh lehishshaen — al avinu shebbashshamayim.

Beikvot meshicha chutzepa yisge veyoker yaamir. haggefen titten piryah vehayyayin beyoker, umalchut tehafech leminut veen tochachat. bet vavad yihye liznut vehaggalil yecherav, vehaggavlan yishshom, veanshe haggevul yesovvu meir leir velo yechonnu,

Vechachmot sofrim tisrach, veyire chet yimmaesu, vehaemet tehe neederet. nearim pene zekenim yalbinu, zekenim yaamdu mippene ketannim — ben menavvevl av, bat kama veimmah, kalla bachamotah, oyve ish anshe veto, pene haddor kifne hakkelev, habben eno mitbayyesh meaviv, veal ma yesh lanu lehishshaen — al avinu shebbashshamayim.

(Gemara) amar rav: lo shanu ella shel melach vegofrit, aval shel hadas veshel vevred — muttar. ushemuel omer: af shel hadas veshel vevred asur, shel kanim veshel chilat — muttar. velevi amar: af shel kanim veshel chilat asur. vechen tane levi bematniteh: af shel kanim veshel chilat asur.

Veal hairus. may "irus"? amar rabbi elazar: tavla dechad pumma. rabba bar rav huna avad leh livreh tanbura, ata avu tavreh, amar leh: michallaf betavla dechad pumma, zil aved leh appumma dechatzba o appumma dikfiza.

Befulemus shel titus gazru al atrot kallot vechulei. may "atrot kallot"? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ir shel zahav. tanya name hachi: ezehu atrot kallot — ir shel zahav, aval ose otah kippa shel melat.

Tana: af al chuppat chatanim gazru. may "chuppat chatanim"? zehoriyyot hammuzehavot. tanya name hachi: ellu hen chuppat chatanim — zehoriyyot hammuzehavot, aval ose pappirit vetole bah kol ma sheyyirtze.

Veshello yelammed et beno yevonit. tanu rabbanan: keshetztzaru malche bet chashmonay ze al ze, haya hurekanos mibbachutz, vearistobbulus mibbifnim. bechol yom vayom hayu meshalshelin dinarim bekuppa, umaalin lahen temidim.

Haya sham zaken echad shehaya makkir bechochmat yevonit, laaz lahem bechochmat yevonit, amar lahen: kol zeman sheoskim baavoda — en nimsarin beyedchem. lemachar shilshelu lahem dinarim bekuppa veheelu lahem chazir. kevan shehiggia lachatzi choma, naatz tzippornav, nizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa.
Otah shaa amru: arur adam sheyyegaddel chazirim, vearur adam sheyyelammed livno chochmat yevonit. veal otah shana shaninu: maase uva omer miggaggot tzerifim, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher.
Ini? vehaamar rabbi: beeretz yisrael lashon suresi lamma? ella i leshon hakkodesh, i leshon yevonit. veamar rav yosef: bevavel leshon arammi lamma? ella o leshon hakkodesh, o lashon parsi!
Leshon yevonit lechud, vechochmat yevonit lechud.

Vechochmat yevonit mi asira? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: may dichtiv "eni olla lenafshi mikkol benot iri" — elef yeladim hayu bevet abba, chamesh meot lamdu tora, vachamesh meot lamdu chochmat yevonit, velo nishtayyer mehen ella ani kan, uven achi abba beasya!

Shane shel bet rabban gamliel, dikrovin lammalchut havo. detanya: mesapper kome hare ze middarche haemori. avtolos ben reuven hittiru [lo] lesapper kome, shehu karov lammalchut. shel bet rabban gamliel hittiru lahen chochmat yevonit, mippene shekkerovin lammalchut.
Befulemus haacharon gazru shello tetze kalla beappiryon vechulei. may tama — mishshum tzeniuta.

Mishshemmet rabban yochanan batla hachochma. tanu rabbanan: mishshemmet rabbi eliezer nignaz sefer tora. mishshemmet rabbi yehoshua batla etza umachshava, mishshemmet rabbi akiva batlu zeroe tora venistattemu mayeynot hachochma.

Mishshemmet rabbi elazar ben azarya batlu atrot chochma, sheateret chachamim oshram". mishshemmet rabbi chanina ben dosa batlu anshe maase. mishshemmet abba yose ben ketonta batlu chasidim, velamma nikra shemo abba yose ben ketonta — shehaya mikketanne chasidim.
Mishshemmet ben azzay batlu hashshakdanin, mishshemmet ben zoma batlu haddarshanin, mishshemmet rabban shimon ben gamliel ala govay verabbu tzarot. mishshemmet rabbi hucheplu tzarot.
Mishshemmet rabbi batla anava veyirat chet. amar leh rav yosef letanna: la titne anava, deikka ana. amar leh rav nachman letanna: la titne yirat chet, deikka ana.
Hadaran alach egla arufa uselika la massechet sota

a: Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam.
Rabban gamliel omer: af hammevi min harkam umin hacheger. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu mikkefar luddim lelod.

Vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", ella hammevi mimmedinat hayyam vehammolich. vehammevi mimmedina limdina bimdinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam". rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu mehegmonya lehegmonya.
Rabbi yehuda omer: merkam lammizrach, urekam – kammizrach; meashkelon laddarom veashkelon – kaddarom; meakko latztzafon, veakko – katztzafon. rabbi meir omer: akko – keeretz yisrael legittin.
Hammevi get beeretz yisrael, eno tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam". veim yesh alav orrim, yitkayyem bechotmav.
Gemara may tama? rabba amar:
b: Lefi sheen bekiin lishmah.
Rava amar: lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deatyuhu be tere. i name, mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael.
I name, beotah medina bimdinat hayyam.
Ulerabba deamar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah – live tere, midde dehave akkol eduyot shebbattora! ed echad neeman beissurin.
Emor deamrinan ed echad neeman beissurin, kegon chaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman, dela ittachzak issura;
Aval hacha, deittachzak issura deeshet ish, have davar shebbaerva; veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim!
Rov bekiin hen. vaafillu lerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta – setam safre dedayyayne migmar gemiri, verabbanan hu deatzruch; vehacha

a: Mishshum igguna akkilu ba rabbanan.
Hay kulla hu?! chumera hu! dei matzrechat leh tere – la ate baal mearer ufasel leh; chad – ate baal umearer ufasel leh!
Kevan deamar mar: bifne kamma notno lah? rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina; chad amar: bifne shenayim, vechad amar: bifne shelosha; meikkara middak dayek, vela ate leoroe nafsheh.
Ulerava deamar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo – live tere, midde dehave akkiyyum shetarot dealma! ed echad neeman beissurin.

Emar deamrinan ed echad neeman beissurin, kegon chaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman, dela ittachzak issura; aval hacha ittachzak issura deeshet ish – have davar shebbaerva, veen davar shebbaerva pachot mishshenayim!

Bedin hu divkiyyum shetarot name la live, kidresh lakish – deamar resh lakish: edim hachatumim al hashshetar, naasu kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din – verabbanan hu deatzruch; vehacha mishshum igguna akkilu ba rabbanan.

Hay kulla hu?! chumera hu! dei matzrechat leh tere – la ate baal mearer ufasel leh; chad – ate baal umearer ufasel leh! kevan deamar mar: bifne kamma notno lah? rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina; chad amar: bifne shenayim, vechad amar: bifne shelosha; meikkara middak dayek vela ate leoroe nafsheh.
Verava, may tama la amar kerabba? amar lach: mi katane "befanay nichtav lishmah, befanay nechtam lishmah"?!
Verabba? bedin hu delitne hachi, ella dei mappeshat leh dibbura – ate lemigzzeyeh.
Hasheta name ate lemigzzeyeh! chada mittelat gaez, chada mittarte la gaez.
Verabba, may tama la amar kerava? amar lach: im ken nitne "befanay nechtam" vetu la; "befanay nichtav" lema li? shema minna baenan lishmah.
Verava? bedin hu delitne hachi, ella deim ken, ate leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma – beed echad.
Verabba: mi dame?! hatam "yadinan", hacha "befanay";
Hatam ishsha la mehemna, hacha ishsha mehemna; hatam baal davar la meheman, hacha baal davar meheman.
Verava amar lach: attu hacha ki amri "yadinan" mi la mehemni?! vechevan dechi amri "yadinan" mehemni, ate leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma – beed echad.
Ulerabba deamar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, man hay tanna devae ketiva lishmah, uvae
b: Chatima lishmah? i rabbi meir – chatima bae, ketiva la bae! ditnan: en kotvin bimchubbar lakkarka. ketavo al hamechubbar lakkarka, telasho, chatamo unetano lah – kasher!

I rabbi elazar – ketiva bae, chatima la bae! vechi tema leolam rabbi elazar hi, vechi la bae rabbi elazar chatima lishmah – middeorayyta, midderabbanan – bae; veha shelosha gittin pesulin derabbanan, vela bae rabbi elazar chatima lishmah!

Ditnan: shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nissat havvalad kasher: katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad – hare ellu shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nissat – havvalad kasher.
Rabbi elazar omer: af al pi sheen alav edim – ella shennetano lah bifne edim; kasher, vegove minnechasim meshuebadim. sheen haedim chotmim al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam.
Veella rabbi meir hi, vechi la bae rabbi meir ketiva lishmah – middeorayyta, midderabbanan bae; veha amar rav nachman, omer haya rabbi meir: afillu metzao beashpa,

a: Vachatamo unetano lah – kasher! vechi tema anan middeorayyta ka matninan la, i hachi, "omer haya rabbi meir devar tora" mibbee leh!
Ella leolam rabbi elazar hi, vechi la bae rabbi elazar chatima – hecha delekka edim kelal; hecha deikka edim – bae. deamar rabbi abba: mode rabbi elazar bimzuyyayf mittocho, shehu pasul.
Rav ashe amar: ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: rabbi yehuda posel, ad shettehe ketivato vachatimato betalush.
Umeikkara may tama la mokminan la kerabbi yehuda?
Mehadderinan arabbi meir, distam matnitin rabbi meir; mehadderinan arabbi elazar, dekayyma lan hilcheta kevoteh begittin.

Tenan, rabban gamliel omer: af hammevi min harkam umin hacheger. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu mikkefar luddim lelod. veamar abbaye: baayayrot hassemuchot leeretz yisrael umuvelaot bitchum eretz yisrael askinan,
Veamar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chaze li hahu atra, vehave kemibbe chubbe lefumebdita.

Mikkelal detanna kamma savar hane la tzerich; may, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehane gemiri; umar savar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, vehane name la shechichi?
La; rabba metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. rabba metaretz letameh: dechulle alma lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehacha beha kamippalgi – tanna kamma savar, hane kevan dismuchot migmar gemiri;
Vaata rabban gamliel lememar, muvelaot gemiri, semuchot la gemiri; vaata rabbi eliezer lememar, muvelaot name la, shello tachlok bimdinat hayyam.
Rava metaretz letameh: dechulle alma lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo – vetanna kamma savar, hane kevan dismuchot mishkach shechichi;
Vaata rabban gamliel lememar, muvelaot shechichi, semuchot la shechichi; vaata rabbi eliezer lememar, muvelaot name la, shello tachlok bimdinat hayyam.

Tenan, vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", ella hammevi mimmedinat hayyam vehammolich. mikkelal detanna kamma savar molich la tzerich; may, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah,
b: Vehane gemiri; umar savar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, vehane name la shechichi?
Rabba metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. rabba metaretz letameh: dechulle alma lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehacha bigzerat molich attu mevi kamippalgi –
Detanna kamma savar: la gazrinan molich attu mevi.
Verabbanan batrae savri: gazrinan molich attu mevi.
Verava metaretz letameh: dechulle alma lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, verabbanan batrae – lefaroshe tameh detanna kamma hu deatu.
