Tenan: hammevi get mimmedina limdina bimdinat hayyam – tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam". ha beotah medina bimdinat hayyam – lo tzarich. lerava nicha, lerabba kashya!
La tema: ha beotah medina bimdinat hayyam – lo tzarich, ella ema: mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael – lo tzarich.
Ha behedya katane la: hammevi get beeretz yisrael, eno tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"! i mehahi, hava amena hane mille diavad, aval lechattechilla la, ka mashma lan.
Veikka demotev la hachi: ha mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael – lo tzarich.
Lerabba nicha, lerava kashya! la tema: mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael – lo tzarich, ella ema: ha beotah medina bimdinat hayyam – lo tzarich.
Aval mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael, may, tzarich?! litne: "hammevi mimmedina limdina" – setam!
Leolam mimmedina limdina beeretz yisrael name lo tzarich, dechevan deikka ole regalim, mishkach shechichi.
Tinach bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym; bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym, may ikka lememar? kevan deikka batte dinin dikvii – mishkach shechichi.

Tenan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu mehegmonya lehegmonya. veamar rabbi yitzchak: ir achat hayta beeretz yisrael vaasasyot shemah, vehayu bah shene hegmonyot shehayu makpidin ze al ze, lefichach hutzerchu lomar mehegmonya lehegmonya.
Lerava nicha, lerabba kashya! rabba it leh derava.
Ella may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deatyu be tere.
I name, beotah medina bimdinat hayyam.
Tenan: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veeno yachol lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", im yesh alav edim – yitkayyem bechotmav. vahavenan ba: may "veeno yachol lomar"?

a: Ilema cheresh, cheresh bar etoye gitta hu?! vehatnan: hakkol kesherim lehavi et hagget, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan!
Veamar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennetano lah keshehu pikkeach, velo hispik lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" ad shennitcharesh. lerava nicha, lerabba kashya!
Hacha bemay askinan – leachar shellamdu. i hachi, yachol name! gezera shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo.
I hachi, eno yachol name! pikkeach venitcharesh milleta dela shechicha, umilleta dela shechicha la gezur ba rabbanan.
Veha ishsha, dela shechicha, utenan: haishsha atzmah mevia gittah, uvilvad shetztzericha lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"? shello tachlok bishlichut.
I hachi, baal name! allema tanya: hu atzmo shehevi gitto, en tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"?
Tama may amur rabbanan tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", dilma ate baal mearar ufasel leh; hasheta minkat naket leh bideh, vearore ka mearar aleh?!

Ta shema, diva minneh shemuel merav huna: shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, tzerichin sheyyomru "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam" o en tzerichin? amar leh: en tzerichin. uma illu yomru "befanenu gershah", mi la mehemni?!
Lerava nicha, lerabba kashya! hacha bemay askinan – leachar shellamdu.
I hachi, chad name! gezera shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo.
I hachi, be tere name! be tere demayytu gitta, milleta dela shechicha; umilleta dela shechicha la gezur bah rabbanan.
Veha ishsha, dela shechicha, utenan: haishsha atzmah mevia gittah, uvilvad shehi atzmah tzericha lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"! shello tachlok bishlichut.

I hachi, baal name! allema tanya: hu atzmo shehevi gitto, eno tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"? tama may amur rabbanan tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" – dilma ate baal mearar ufasel leh; hasheta minkat naket leh bideh, vearore ka mearar aleh?!

Ta shema: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, unetano lah velo amar lah "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", im nitkayyem bechotmav – kasher, veim lav – pasul. heve lo hutzerchu lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" lehachamir aleha, ella lehakel aleha.
Lerava nicha, lerabba kashya! hacha bemay askinan – leachar shellamdu.
Vehaamrat: gezera shemma yachzor haddavar lekilkulo! keshennisat. i hachi, heve la hutzerchu lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" lehachemir aleha ella lehakel aleha?! mishshum denissat hu!
Hachi kaamar: vechi tema lehachamir ala velappeka, heve lo hutzerchu lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" lehachemir aleha ella lehakel aleha,
b: Tama may – dilma ate baal mearar ufasel leh; hasheta baal la ka mearar, anan nekum unearar ala?!
Biflugeta derabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vechad amar: lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo.

Tistayyem derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, derabbi shimon bar abba ayyti gitta lekammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, vaamar leh: tzerichna lememar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", o la?
Amar leh: la tzerichat, lo amru ella bedorot harishonim, sheen bekiin lishmah, aval bedorot haacharonim divkiin lishmah – lo. tistayyem.
Vetisbera?! veha rabba it leh derava! veod, ha amrinan shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo!
Ella rabbi shimon bar abba inish acharina hava bahadeh, veha dela chashev leh – mishshum kevodo derabbi shimon.
Ittemar: bifne kamma notno lah? rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina; chad amar: bifne shenayim, vechad amar: bifne shelosha.

Tistayyem derabbi yochanan hu deamar bifne shenayim, deravin bar rav chisda ayyti gitta lekammeh derabbi yochanan, vaamar leh: zil hav lah beappe tere, veema lehu "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam". tistayyem.
Lema beha kamippalgi, deman deamar bifne shenayim, kasavar: lefi sheen bekiin lishmah; uman deamar bifne shelosha, kasavar: lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo?
Vetisbera?! ha midderabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, rabbi yochanan amar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, vehacha hechi kaamar rabbi yochanan bifne shenayim?
Veod, ha rabba it leh derava!

Ella, dechulle alma baenan edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, vehacha beshaliach naase ed veed naase dayyayn kamippalgi: man deamar bifne shenayim, kasavar: shaliach naase ed, veed naase dayyayn. uman deamar bifne shelosha, kasavar: shaliach naase ed, veen ed naase dayyayn.
Veha kayyma lan bidrabbanan deed naase dayyayn!
Ella hacha beha kamippalgi, demar savar: kevan deishsha keshera lehavi et hagget, zimnin demayyta leh itteta vesamchi ala.
Veiddach: ishsha – midda yadi vela samchi ala.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, unetano lah velo amar lah "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" – yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: en havvalad mamzer. ketzad yaase? yittelennu hemenna, veyachazor veyittenennu lah bifne shenayim, veyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam".
Verabbi meir, mishshum delo amar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", yotzi vehavvalad mamzer?
In, rabbi meir letameh. deamar rav hamenuna mishshemeh deulla: omer haya rabbi meir: kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin – yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer.
Bar hedya bae leetoye gitta, ata lekammeh derabbi achay, dahava memunne aggitte, amar leh: tzarich atta laamod al kol ot vaot. ata lekammeh derabbi amme verabbi assi, amri leh: la tzerichat.
Vechi tema eeved lechumera, nimtza atta motzi laaz al gittin harishonim.
Rabba bar bar chana ayyti gitta, palga ikketav kammeh ufalga la ikketav kammeh. ata lekammeh derabbi elazar, amar leh: afillu lo katav bo ella shita achat lishmah, shuv eno tzarich. rav ashe amar:

a: Afillu kan kulemosa vekan megilleta.
Tanya kevoteh derav ashe: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam – afillu hu babbayit vesofer baaliyyay, hu baaliyyay vesofer babbayit – afillu nichnas veyotze kol hayyom kullo, kasher.
Hu babbayit vesofer baaliyyay?! ha la ka chaze leh! ella lav kegon dishma kan kulemosa vekan megilleta.

Amar mar: afillu nichnas veyotze kol hayyom kullo – kasher. man? ilema shaliach, hasheta hu babbayit vesofer baaliyyay, dela chaze leh – amrat kasher, nichnas veyotze mibbaya?! ella sofer? peshita! mishshum denichnas veyotze nifselinneh?!
La tzericha, dinfak leshuka vaata; mahu detema, inish acharina ashkecheh vaamar leh, ka mashma lan.
Ittemar: bavel; rav amar: keeretz yisrael legittin, ushemuel amar: kechutza laaretz.
Lema beha ka mippalgi: demar savar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehane gemiri; umar savar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo, vehane name la shechichi.
Vetisbera?! ha rabba it leh derava!
Ella, dechulle alma baenan lekayyeymo; rav savar: kevan deikka metivata, mishkach shechichi; ushemuel savar: metivata begirsayyhu teridi.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi abba amar rav huna: asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael legittin, mikki ata rav levavel.

Metiv rabbi yirmeya: rabbi yehuda omer: merkam lemizrach, urekam – kammizrach, meashkelon laddarom, veashkelon – kaddarom, meakko latztzafon, veakko – katztzafon. veha bavel litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayyma, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai elay mitztzafon tippatach haraa",
Utenan, rabbi meir omer: akko – keeretz yisrael legittin; vaafillu rabbi meir la kaamar ella beakko dimkarva, aval bavel dimrachaka, la! hu motev la vehu mefarek la: levar mibbavel.
Ad hechan hi bavel? amar rav pappa: kemachaloket leyuchasin, kach machaloket legittin. verav yosef amar: machaloket leyuchasin, aval legittin divre hakkol ad arba tinyayna degishra.
Rav chisda matzrech meaktesfon leve ardashir, umibbe ardashir leaktesfon la matzrech. lema kasavar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehane gemiri?
Vetisbera?! veha rabba it leh derava! ella dechulle alma baenan lekayyeymo; vehane, kevan deazli leshuka lehatam – hanach yadi bachatimot yeda dehane,
Vehane bidhanach la yadi. may tama? beshukayyhu teridi.
Rabba bar avu matzrech mearsa learsa, rav sheshet matzrech mishshechuna lishchuna, verava matzrech beotah shechuna.
Veha rava hu deamar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo? shane bene machoza, denayydi.

Rav chanin mishtae: rav kahana ayyti gitta, vela yadana i missura linhardea, i minnehardea lesura. ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: tzerichna lememar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", o la tzerichna? amar leh: la tzerichat,
b: Vei avadt – ahnet. may "i avadt ahnet"? dei ate baal mearar, la mashgechinan beh.

Kidtanya: maase beadam echad shehevi get lifne rabbi yishmael, amar lo: tzarich ani lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", o eni tzarich? amar lo: beni, mehechan atta? amar lo: rabbi, mikkefar sisay ani. amar lo: tzarich atta lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", shello tizzakek leedim.

Leachar sheyyatza, nichnas lefanav rabbi ilay, amar lo: rabbi, vahalo kefar sisay muvelaat bitchum eretz yisrael, ukerova letzippori yoter meakko; utenan, rabbi meir omer: akko – keeretz yisrael legittin, vaafillu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella beakko dimrachaka, aval kefar sisay dimkarva – la!
Amar lo: shetok beni, shetok, hoil veyatza haddavar behetter – yatza.
Ha ihu name, "shello tizzakek leedim" kaamar leh! la sayyeymuha kammeh.
Shelach leh rabbi evyatar lerav chisda: gittin habbaim mishsham lechan, en tzarich lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam". lema kasavar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, vehane gemiri?
Vetisbera?! veha rabba it leh derava! ella, dechulle alma baenan lekayyeymo, vechevan deikka rabbim desalki venachati – mishkach shechichi.

Amar rav yosef: man lema lan derabbi evyatar bar samcha hu? veod, ha ihu dishlach leh lerav yehuda: bene adam haolin mishsham lechan, hen kiyyeymu beatzman: "vayyittenu (et) hayyeled bazzona vehayyalda machru vayyayin vayyishtu", uchetav leh bela sirtut;
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: shetayim kotvin, shalosh en kotvin; bematnita tana: shalosh kotvin, arba en kotvin!
Amar leh abbaye: attu kol dela yada ha derabbi yitzchak, lav gavra rabba hu?! bishlama milleta detalya bisvara – lechayye; ha – gemara hi, ugemara la shemia leh.
Veod, ha rabbi evyatar hu deaskem mareh al yedeh; dichtiv: "vattizne alav pilagsho", rabbi evyatar amar: zevuv matza lah. rabbi yonatan amar: nima matza lah.
Veashkecheh rabbi evyatar leeliyyahu, amar leh: may ka aved hakkadosh baruch hu? amar leh: asek befilegesh baggiva. umay kaamar? amar leh: evyatar beni kach hu omer, yonatan beni kach hu omer.
Amar leh: chas veshalom, umi ikka sefeka kamme shemayya?! amar leh: ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim hen – zevuv matza velo hikpid, nima matza vehikpid.
Amar rav yehuda: zevuv bakkeara, venima beoto makom; zevuv – meisuta, venima – sakkanta. ikka deamri: idde veidde bakkeara; zevuv – unesa, venima – peshiuta.
Amar rav chisda: leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto, shehare pilegesh baggiva hetil aleha baalah ema yetera, vehippila kamma revavot miyyisrael.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammetil ema yetera betoch beto, sof hu ba lide shalosh averot: gilluy arayot, ushefichut damim, vechillul shabbat.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: ha deamri rabbanan: shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha: issartem? eravtem? hadeliku et hanner! tzarich

a: Lememrinhu benichuta, ki hechi delikabbelu minneh. amar rav ashe: ana la shemia li ha derabba bar bar chana, vekiyyaymtiha missevara.
Amar rabbi avahu: leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto, shehare adam gadol hetil ema yetera betoch beto veheechiluhu davar gadol.
Umannu? rabbi chanina ben gamliel. heechiluhu salka datach?! hasheta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadam, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken?
Ella bikkeshu lehaachilo davar gadol. umay nihu? ever min hachay.
Shelach leh mar ukeva lerabbi elazar: bene adam haomdim alay, uveyadi lemosram lammalchut, mahu?
Sirtet uchetav leh: "amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom beod rasha lenegdi" – af al pi sherasha lenegdi, eshmera lefi machsom.

Shelach leh: ka metzaari li tuva, vela matzena deekum behu. shelach leh: "dom laAdonai vehitcholel lo" – dom laAdonai, vehu yappilem lecha chalalim chalalim; hashekem vehaarev alehen levet hammidrash, vehen kalin meelehen. haddavar yatza mippi rabbi elazar, unetanuhu ligniva bekolar.
Shelachu leh lemar ukeva: zimra mena lan daasir? sirtet uchetav lehu: "al tismach yisrael el gil beammim".
Velishlach lehu mehacha: "bashshir lo yishtu yayin yemar shechar leshotav"! i mehahu, hava amena hane mille zimra demana, aval defumma shere, ka mashma lan.
Amar leh rav huna bar natan lerav ashe: may dichtiv "kina vedimona veadada"? amar leh: matvavta deeretz yisrael kachashev.
Amar leh: attu ana la yadana dematvavta deeretz yisrael ka chashev?! ella rav geviha mearaggiza amar bah tama: kol sheyyesh lo kina al chavero vedomem, shochen ade ad ose lo din.

Amar leh: ella meatta, "tziklag umadmena vesansannah" hachi name?! amar leh: i hava rav geviha mibbe araggiza hacha, hava amar bah tama. rav acha mibbe chozaa amar ba hachi: kol mi sheyyesh lo tzaakat legima al chavero, vedomem, shochen bassene ose lo din.
Amar leh resh galuta lerav huna: kelila mena lan deasur? amar leh: midderabbanan, ditnan: bappulemus shel aspasyaynus gazru al atrot chatanim veal hairus.
Addehachi kam rav huna leippenoye, amar leh rav chisda, kera ketiv: "ko amar Adonai elohim hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara zot lo zot hashshafala hagebeah vehaggavoah hashepil" –
Vechi ma inyan mitznefet etzel atara? ella lomar lach: bizman shemmitznefet berosh kohen gadol – atara berosh kol adam, nistalleka mitznefet merosh kohen gadol – nistalleka atara merosh kol adam.
Addehachi ata rav huna, ashkechinhu dahave yatvi, amar leh: haelohim! midderabbanan, ella chisda shemach vechisdain millach.
Ravina ashkecheh lemar bar rav ashe dahava gadel kelila livratteh, amar leh: la savar la mar: "hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara"?! amar leh: dumeya dechohen gadol – begavre, aval binshe – la.

May "zot lo zot"? daresh rabbi avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derav amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derav assi: beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: "hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara", amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, zot lahen leyisrael, shehikdimu lefanecha besinay "naase" lenishma"?!
Amar lahen: lo zot lahen leyisrael, shehishpilu et haggavoah vehigbihu et hashshafel, veheemidu tzelem bahechol?!

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derav amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derav assi – may dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai im shelemim vechen rabbim vechen nagozzu veavar vegomer"? im roe adam shemmezonotav metzumetzamin – yaase mehen tzedaka. vechol shekken keshehen merubbin.

May "vechen nagozzu veavar"? tana deve rabbi yishmael: kol haggozez minnechasav veose mehen tzedaka – nitztzal middinah shel gehinnam. mashal lishte rechelot shehayu ovrot bemayim, achat gezuza veachat enah gezuza; gezuza avra, vesheenah gezuza lo avra.
b: "Veinnitich" – amar mar zutera: afillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka, yaase tzedaka. "lo aannech od" – tane rav yosef: shuv en marin lo simane aniyyut.

Rabbi yehuda omer, mirkam lammizrach kulei: lememra deakko litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayyma?! ureminhu: haya mehallech meakko lichziv; mimino – lemizrach hadderech – temea mishshum eretz haammim, ufetura min hammaaser umin hashsheviit, ad sheyyivvada lach shehi chayyevet.

Missemolo – lemaarav hadderech – tehora mishshum eretz haammim, vechayyevet bemaaser uvishviit, ad sheyyivvada lach shehi petura. ad hechan? ad keziv. rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: ad lavlavo.

Amar abbaye: retzua nafka. veyahev tanna simana hachi?! in; kera name yahev simana, dichtiv: "vayyomru hinne chag Adonai beshilo miyyamim yamima asher mitztzefona levet el, mizrecha hashshemesh limsilla haola mibbet el shechema, uminnegev lilvona", veamar rav pappa: lemizrachah shel mesilla.
Tana chada: hammevi get bisfina – kemevi beeretz yisrael, vetanya iddach – kemevi bechutza laaretz!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: la kashya, ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbanan. ditnan: afar chutza laaretz habba bisfina laaretz – chayyayv bemaaser uvishviit.
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman shehassefina gosheshet, aval en hassefina gosheshet – patur.
Abbaye amar: ha veha rabbi yehuda hi, vela kashya: kan bizman sheen hassefina gosheshet, kan bizman shehassefina gosheshet.
Amar rabbi zera: atzitz nakuv hammunnach al gabbe yetedot, banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan.
Amar rava: dilma la hi – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella bisfina,

a: Haasuya livroach, aval atzitz, sheeno asuy livroach – lo.
I name: ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bisfina, dela mafsek avvera – demayya ki ara semichta damya; aval atzitz, demafsek avvera – la.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: binharot deeretz yisrael dechulle alma la peligi. ella ki peligi – bayyam haggadol.

Detanya: ezehu eretz veezehu chutza laaretz? kol sheshshofea veyored mitture amnon velifnim – eretz yisrael; mitture amnon velachutz – chutza laaretz. hannissin shebbayyam – roin otan keillu chut matuach alehem mitture amnon ad nachal mitzrayim; min hachut velifnim – eretz yisrael; min hachut velachutz – chutza laaretz.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol shekkeneged eretz yisrael – hare hu keeretz yisrael, shenneemar: "ugevul yam, vehaya lachem hayyam haggadol ugevul, ze yihye lachem gevul yam".

Vehannissin shebbatztzedadin, roin otan keillu chut matuach alehen mikkaflureya vead yam okyaynos, uminnachal mitzrayim vead yam okyaynos; min hachut velifnim – eretz yisrael, min hachut velachutz – chutza laaretz.
Verabbanan, hay "ugevul" may avdi leh? mibbee leh lenissin. verabbi yehuda, nissin la tzerichi kera.
Rabbi meir omer: akko – keeretz yisrael vechulei: beo minneh merabbi chiyyay bar abba: hammocher avdo lesureya, kemocher bechutza laaretz dame, o la?
Amar lehu: tenetuha, rabbi meir omer: akko – keeretz yisrael legittin; legittin – in, laavadim – la, vechol shekken sureya dimrachaka tuva.

Tanu rabbanan: bishlosha derachim shavvta sureya leeretz yisrael, uvishlosha lechutza laaretz. (siman: av bar rak). afarah tame – kechutza laaretz, vehammocher avdo lesureya – kemocher bechutza laaretz. vehammevi get missureya – kemevi mechutza laaretz.
Uvishlosha leeretz yisrael: chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit – keeretz yisrael, veharotze likkanes lah betohora – nichnas, vehakkone sade besureya –
b: Kekonah befarvare yerushalayim. chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit keeretz yisrael – kasavar kibbush yachid shemeh kibbush.
Veharotze likkanes lah betohora nichnas – vehaamrat afarah tame? beshidda, teva umigdal.

Detanya: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal – rabbi metamme, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher. vaafillu rabbi la ka metamme ella beeretz haammim, degazru al gushah veal avirah, aval sureya, al gushah gazru, al avirah lo gazru.
Vehakkone sade besureya kekonah befarvare yerushalayim – lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lomar shekkotvin alav ono, vaafillu beshabbat.
Beshabbat salka datach?! kidamar rava: omer legoy veose; hacha name omer legoy veose. veaf al gav daamira legoy shevut, mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael – la gezur rabbanan.
Tanu rabbanan: eved shehevi gitto, vechatuv bo: "atzmecha unechasayy kenuyin lach", atzmo – kana, nechasim – lo kana.
Ibbaya lehu: "kol nechasayy kenuyin lach", mahu? amar abbaye: mittoch shekkana atzmo, kana nechasim.
Amar leh rava: bishlama atzmo likne, midde dehave agget ishsha, ella nechasim la likne, midde dehave akkiyyum shetarot dealma!
Hadar amar abbaye: mittoch shello kana nechasim – lo kana atzmo. amar leh rava: bishlama nechasim la likne, midde dehave akkiyyum shetarot dealma, ella atzmo likne, midde dehave agget ishsha!
Ella amar rava: echad ze veechad ze, atzmo – kana, nechasim – lo kana. amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava: keman – kerabbi shimon, deamar palginan dibbura;
Ditnan: hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo – yatza ben chorin. shiyyer karka kol shehu, lo yatza ben chorin. rabbi shimon omer:

a: Leolam hu ben chorin, ad sheyyomar "kol nechasayy netunin lifloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen".

Vehaamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: af al pi shekkilles rabbi yose et rabbi shimon – halacha kerabbi meir, detanya: keshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yose, kara alav hammikra hazze: "sefatayim yishshak meshiv devarim nechochim"!
Umi amar rav nachman hachi? vehaamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leavdo, veamad – chozer bannechasim, veeno chozer baeved.
Chozer bannechasim – mattenat shechiv mera hu, veeno chozer baeved – shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin!
Ella amar rav ashe: hatam hayeynu tama, mishshum delav kerut gitta hu.
Im yesh alav orrin, yitkayyem bechotmav: arar kamma? ilema arar chad, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: divre hakkol en arar pachot mishshenayim!
Veella arar tere? tere utere ninhu, may chazet desamchat ahane, semoch ahane! ella arar devaal.
Mishna hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veeno yachol lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", im yesh alav edim – yitkayyem bechotmav.
Echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim, shavu lammolich velammevi, vezo achat min hadderachim sheshshavu gitte nashim leshichrure avadim.
Gemara may "eno yachol lomar"? ilema cheresh, cheresh bar etoye gitta hu?! vehatnan: hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan!
Amar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennetano lah keshehu pikkeach, velo hispik lomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" ad shennitcharesh.

Echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim: tanu rabbanan: bishlosha derachim shavu gitte nashim leshichrure avadim: shavu lammolich velammevi; vechol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti – pasul, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim; vechol hashshetarot
b: Haolim bearkaot shel goyim, af al pi shechotmehen goyim – kesherin, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. uchedivre rabbi meir – bearbaa: haomer "ten get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi", ratza lachazor bishnehem – yachzor, divre rabbi meir.
Bishlama lerabbanan, minyana lemaote ha derabbi meir. ella lerabbi meir, minyana lemaote may?
Lemaote ha detanya: edim sheen yodim lachtom, mekarin lahem neyayr chalak, umemalleim et hakkeraim deyo.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – begitte nashim, aval shichrure avadim ushear kol hashshetarot, im yodin likrot velachtom – chotmin, veim lav – en chotmin.
Keriyyay man dechar shemay? chassore mechassera vehachi katane: edim sheen yodin likrot – korin lifnehem vechotmin, vesheen yodin lachtom – mekarin lahem.
Vetu lekka?! vehaikka: haomer "tenu get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi", umet – lo yittenu leachar mita, "tenu mane lifloni", umet – yittenu leachar mita.
Ki katane, milleta deletay bishtarot, milleta deitay bishtarot la katane.
Dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu: hevu yodin, sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu: shechiv mera sheamar "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – en kotvin venotnin,
Shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita.
Vehaikka lishmah?
Bishlama lerabba, hayeynu molich umevi. ella lerava, kashya!
Vetu: ben lerabba ben lerava, haikka mechubbar! ki katane pesula derabbanan, deorayyta la katane.
Veha arkaot shel goyim, difsula deorayyta hu, vekatane! beede mesira, ucherabbi elazar deamar: ede mesira karti.
Veha middekatane sefa, rabbi shimon omer: af ellu kesherin, veamar rabbi zera: yarad rabbi shimon leshitato shel rabbi elazar, deamar ede mesira karti; mikkelal detanna kamma savar – la!

a: Ikka benayyhu shemot muvehakin.
Veha chazara deorayyta, vekatane!
Ella ki katane – milleta deleta bekiddushin, milleta deita bekiddushin – la katane.
Veha chazara gufa ita bekiddushin! bishlichut beal korchah, divgerushin ita uvekiddushin leta.
Mishna kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti – pasul, chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. maase sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha, vehayu edav ede chutim, vehichshir.
Gemara manni matnitin? la tanna kamma, vela rabbi elazar, vela rabban shimon ben gamliel!

Detanya: matztzat kuti – mutteret, veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach. rabbi elazar oser, lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzvot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim – harebe medakdekin bah, yoter miyyisrael.
Manni? i tanna kamma, afillu shear shetarot name! i rabbi elazar, afillu get ishsha name la!
Vei rabban shimon ben gamliel; i deachzuk – afillu shear shetarot name, i dela achzuk – afillu get ishsha name la!
Vechi tema rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, udeachzuk beha vela achzuk beha, i hachi, may irya chad? afillu tere name! allema amar rabbi elazar: lo hichshiru bo ella ed echad kuti bilvad?
Leolam rabbi elazar, uchegon dechatem yisrael levassof,
b: Dei lav dechuti chaver hava, la machtem leh mikkammeh. i hachi, afillu shear shetarot name!
Ella amrinan ravvcha shevak leman dekashshish minneh; hacha name, ravvcha shevak leman dekashshish minneh!
Amar rav pappa, zot omeret, ede hagget en chotmin ze belo ze.
May tama? amar rav ashe: gezera mishshum "kullechem".
Gufa, amar rabbi elazar: lo hichshiru bo ella ed echad kuti bilvad. may ka mashma lan? tenena: kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti – pasul kulei!
I mimmatnitin, hava amena afillu tere name; vehay dekatane chad, mishshum devishtarot afillu chad name la, ka mashma lan.
Utere la?! veha katane: maase veheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha, vehayu edav ede chutim, vehichshir! amar abbaye, teni: "edo".

Rava amar: leolam tere, verabban gamliel miflag pelig; vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: verabban gamliel machshir bishnayim, umaase name sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha, vehayu edav ede chutim, vehichshir.

Mishna kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel goyim, af al pi shechotmehem goyim – kesherim; chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim. rabbi shimon omer: af ellu kesherin, lo huzekru ella bizman shennaasu behedyot.
Gemara ka pasek vetane – la shena mecher la shena mattana.
Bishlama mecher, mikki yahev zuze kammayyhu hu dikna; ushetara reaya bealma hu – dei la yahev zuze kammayyhu, la havo mari nafshayyhu vechatvin leh shetara.
Ella mattana, bemay ka kane – lav behay shetara? vehay shetara chaspa bealma hu! amar shemuel: dina demalchuta – dina.
Veibbaet ema, tane "chutz mikkegitte nashim".
Rabbi shimon omer: af ellu, kesherin vechulei: veha lav bene cheritut ninhu?
Amar rabbi zera: yarad rabbi shimon leshitato shel rabbi elazar, deamar ede mesira karti.
Vehaamar rabbi abba: mode rabbi elazar bimzuyyaf mittocho, sheppasul! hacha bemay askinan –

a: Beshemot muvehakin.
Hechi dame shemot muvehakin? amar rav pappa, kegon: hormiz, vaavudayyana, bar shivtay, uvar kidre, uvati, unekim unna.

Aval shemot sheen muvehakim may – la?! i hachi, addetane sefa: lo huzekru ella bizman shennaasu behedyot; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – beshemot muvehakin, aval shemot sheen muvehakin – la!
Hachi name kaamar: bamme devarim amurim – beshemot muvehakin, aval beshemot sheen muvehakin, naasa kemi shennaasu behedyot, ufesulin.
Veibbaet ema: sefa atan legitte mamon, vehachi kaamar: lo huzekru gitte mamon difsulim, ella bizman shennaasu behedyot.

Tanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose, kach amar rabbi shimon lachachamim betzaydan: lo nechleku rabbi akiva vachachamim al kol hashshetarot haolin bearkaot shel goyim, sheaf al pi shechotmehen goyim – kesherim, vaafillu gitte nashim veshichrure avadim; lo nechleku ella bizman shennaasu behedyot – sherabbi akiva machshir, vachachamim poslim – chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af ellu – kesherin bimkom sheen yisrael chotmin, aval bimkom sheyyisrael chotmin – la.
Mekom sheen yisrael chotmin name, ligzor attu mekom sheyyisrael chotmin! shemma bishma michallaf, atra beatra la michallaf.
Ravina savar leachshore bichnufeyata dearmae, amar leh rafram: "arkaot" tenan.
Amar rava: hay shetara parsaa, demasreh nihaleh beappe sahade yisrael – magbinan beh mibbene chare.
Veha la yadi lemikre? bidyadi.
Veha baena ketav sheeno yachol lezayyef, velekka! bedaafitzan. veha baena "tzarich sheyyachazir meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona", velekka! bidmahdar.
I hachi mimmeshabedi name! let leh kala.
Bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan:
b: Edim hachatumin al hagget ushemotan keshemot goyim, mahu? amar leh: la ba leyadenu ella lokus velus, vehichsharnu.
Vedavka lokus velus, dela shechichi yisrael demasseki bishmahatayyhu, aval shemahata acharine dishchichi yisrael demasseki bishmahatayyhu – la.
Etiveh: gittin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam veedim chatumim alehem, af al pi sheshshemotehen kishmot goyim – kesherin, mippene sherov yisrael shebbechutza laaretz shemotehen kishmot goyim.
Hatam, kidkatane tama: mippene sherov yisrael shebbechutza laaretz shemotehen kishmot goyim.
Veikka deamri, ki matnita bea minneh, ufeshat leh mimmatnita.
Mishna haomer "ten get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi", im ratza lachazor bishnehen – yachzor, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: begitte nashim, aval lo beshichrure avadim; lefi shezzachin laadam shello befanav, veen chavin lo ella befanav;
Sheim yirtze shello lazun et avdo – rashshay, veshello lazun et ishto – eno rashshay.
Amar lahem: vahare hu posel et avdo min hatteruma, keshem shehu posel et ishto! amru lo: mippene shehu kinyayno.
Gemara yatev rav huna verav yitzchak bar yosef kammeh derabbi yirmeya, veyatev rabbi yirmeya veka menamnem, veyatev rav huna vekaamar: shema minna midderabbanan, hattofes levaal chov, kana.
Amar leh rav yitzchak bar yosef: vaafillu bimkom shechav laacherim? amar leh: in.
Addehachi ittear behu rabbi yirmeya. amar lehu: dardeke! hachi amar rabbi yochanan: hattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim – lo kana. veim tomar: mishnatenu!
Kol haomer "tenu", keomer "zechu" dame.

Amar rav chisda: hattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim, banu lemachloket rabbi eliezer verabbanan. ditnan: mi shellikket et happea, veamar "hare zo lifloni ani", rabbi eliezer amar: zacha lo, vachachamim omrim: yittenennu leani hannimtza rishon.
Amar ammemar, veittema rav pappa:

a: Dilma la hi; ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam, ella demiggo dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh, vehave ani vachaze leh – umiggo dezache leh lenafsheh zache lechavreh; aval hacha, la.
Vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella dichtiv: "lo telakket leani" – lo telakket lo leani; aval hacha, la.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "lo telakket" – may aved leh? mibbee leh lehazehir leani al shello.
Sheim yirtze shello lazun kulei: shamat minna, yachol harav lomar laeved: "ase immi veeni zanach"?
Hacha bemay askinan – daamar leh: "tze maase yadecha limzonotecha".
Dichvota gabbe ishsha – daamar la: "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich"?! ishsha ammay la? ishsha – bidla safka.
Eved name bidla safek! avda dinhom kereseh la shave, lemareh ulemarteh lemay mitbee?

Ta shema: eved sheggala leare miklat en rabbo chayyayv lezuno, velo od ella shemmaase yadav lerabbo. shema minna, yachol harav lomar laeved "ase immi veeni zanach"! hacha bemay askinan, deamar lo: "tze maase yadecha limzonotecha".
I hachi, maase yadav ammay lerabbo? lehaedafa.
Haadafa, peshita! mahu detema, kevan dechi let leh la yahev leh, ki it leh name la lishkol minneh, ka mashma lan.
Umay shena leare miklat? salka datach amena: "vachay" – aved leh chiyyuta tefe, ka mashma lan.
Veha middekatane sefa: aval ishsha sheggalta leare miklat – balah chayyayv bimzonoteha; mikkelal dela amar la, dei amar la, bala ammay chayyayv?
Umiddesefa dela amar la, resha name dela amar leh!
Leolam daamar leh, veishsha bidla safka.

Veha middekatane sefa: veim amar lah "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich" – rashshay, mikkelal deresha dela amar la! hachi kaamar: veim maspeket, veamar la: "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich" – rashshay.
Maspeket, may lememra? mahu detema: "kol kevudda vat melech penima", ka mashma lan.
Lema ketannae – rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yachol haeved lomar lerabbo bishne vatztzoret: "o parneseni, o hotzieni lecherut". vachachamim omrim: harshut beyad rabbo.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: yachol, umar savar: eno yachol?
Vetisbera?! hay "o parneseni o hotzieni lecherut"?! "o parneseni o ten li maase yaday befarnasati" mibbee leh! veod: may shena bishne vatztzoret?
Ella hacha bemay askinan – deamar lo "tze maase yadecha limzonotecha", uvishne vatztzoret la safek;
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: o parneseni o hotzieni lecherut, ki hechi dechazu li inashe umerachamin alay. verabbanan savri: man dimrachem abbene chare, aeved name rachome merachem.
Ta shema, deamar rav: hammakdish yede avdo, oto haeved love veochel, veose uforea. shema minna, yachol harav lomar laeved: "ase immi veeni zanach"!
Hacha bemay askinan – bemaale lo mezonot. i hachi, lemay
b: Love veochel? lehaedafa.
Velema leh hekdesh: ad hasheta saggi lach bela haadafa, vehasheta name tisge lach bela haadafa! hekdesh gufeh nicha leh, ki hechi delashbach avdeh.
Ose uforea, kamma kamma kadesh leh! befachot pachot mishshave peruta.
Hachi name mistabbera; deamar rav: hammakdish yede avdo – oto haeved ose veochel, dei la avda man palach leh.
I amrat bishlama hach bemaale veeno yachol, veha besheeno maale, shappir.
Ella i amrat hach besheeno maale, veyachol, dei la avda man palach leh?! man devae niflecheh!
Ella lav, shema minna eno yachol! shema minna.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan: hakkotea yad avdo shel chavero – noten shivto urefuato lerabbo, veoto haeved nizzon min hatztzedaka. shema minna, yachol harav lomar laeved: "ase immi veeni zanach"!
Hacha bemay askinan – bemaale lo mezonot. i hachi, ammay nizzon min hatztzedaka? lehaedafa.
I hachi, "nizzon"?! "mitparnes" mibbee leh! ella lav, shema minna yachol! shema minna.
Amar mar: noten shivto urefuato lerabbo. shivto, peshita! refuato itztericha leh.
Refuato dideh hi, devae ittassoye be! la tzericha, deamdu lechamsha yome, vaavadu leh samma charifa veittassi bitlata yome; mahu detema: tzaara – dideh hu, ka mashma lan.

Tanya: amar rabbi elazar, amarnu lo lemeir: vahalo zechut hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat yede rabbo lecherut! amar lanu: chov hu lo – sheim haya eved kohen, poslo min hatteruma. amarnu lo: vahalo ma im yirtze shello lezuno veshello lefarneso, rashshay!
Amar lanu: uma illu eved kohen shebbarach, veeshet kohen shemmarda al balah – halo ochlin bitruma; veze – eno ochel. aval ishsha – chov hu lah, shekken poslah min hatteruma umafsidah min hammezonot.
May kaamru leh, umay ka mahdar lehu? hachi kaamar lehu: hashavtuni al hammezonot, ma teshivuni al hatteruma?
Vechi temru: i bae, zarek leh gitta ufasel leh; shavek leh vearek veazel lealma.
